kyoto_nakagawa_saketen_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: Okinawa soba, fu champuru, island gyoza and mozuku tempura (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_nakagawa_saketen_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-based Okinawan dishes and gyoza (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_nakagawa_saketen_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday 18:00–24:00; Friday and Saturday 18:00–1:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥300 (Tabelog original お付き出し300円). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog). 25 seats: 5 at the counter, 20 at tables, some by the window; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog; 2013 reviews). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). 2F of the Radice Matsuya building on Kiyamachi south of Oike; near Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_nakagawa_saketen_kiyamachi.notes: [Okinawan dining bar · Kiyamachi-Oike, 2F] A dim, plant-filled second-floor bar playing reggae, run by a friendly couple: mozuku tempura, fu champuru, island gyoza and Okinawa soba with Orion beer and a wall of awamori. ¥300 appetizer; smoking allowed. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-running Okinawan dining bar despite the "saketen" (liquor shop) name, with a sister shop in Demachi, ingredients from Okinawa and a counter lined with awamori; a February 2025 guest found the owner couple both charming.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor praised the owner couple and the menu's tasting notes for the many awamori, and especially the mozuku tempura.
A May 2024 Okinawa fan comes back for the mozuku tempura, fu champuru, island gyoza and Okinawa soba.
A February 2013 diner laughed that a place called "Saketen" turned out to be an Okinawan restaurant with a night view from the window tables.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・沖縄料理・居酒屋、中京区木屋町御池南入る下丸屋町421-5 ラディーチェ・マツヤビル 2F、市役所前から156m、月・水・木・日 18:00〜24:00、金・土 18:00〜翌1:00、火曜休み、予約可、お付き出し300円、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・PayPay 可、25席 (カウンター5、テーブル20)、20〜50名で貸切可、喫煙可、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2008年11月〜2025年2月、英語): 「酒店」だが沖縄料理の店、レゲエと南国の雰囲気、沖縄から直送の食材、もずくの天ぷら、麩チャンプルー、島餃子、沖縄コロッケ、ゴーヤーチャンプルー、沖縄そば、オリオンビール、泡盛がずらり、泡盛のカクテル、店主夫婦が気さく (2025年2月)、窓際の席から夜景 (2013年)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥300 appetizer; smoking allowed; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through February 2025.

kyoto_rakushokushu_wanya_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushikatsu in batter and breadcrumbs is the house speciality (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_rakushokushu_wanya_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kushikatsu, oden, sashimi, oysters (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_rakushokushu_wanya_gion.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 18:00–04:00 (food L.O. 03:00, drinks 03:30); closed Sundays, Mondays and holidays (Tabelog). Bookings advised around 7 pm (January 2025 review). Starter charge ¥350 (Tabelog Japanese original 「350円（付き出し）」). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter and a sunken-kotatsu room for 6; smoking allowed (Tabelog). In Gion north of Shijo, 5 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_rakushokushu_wanya_gion.notes: [Kushikatsu & oden · Gion] A small, friendly counter in Gion run by a couple, serving kushikatsu, oden, sashimi and fresh oysters at reasonable prices until 4 am, to locals, overseas visitors and the late-night trade. About ¥5,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2015 (Tabelog). Run by the chef, who trained at a well-known restaurant, and the chef's wife (November 2024 review); a January 2025 regular mentions a change of head chef that lifted the presentation. Run by a friendly couple (November 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A regular who dropped by with souvenirs in April 2025 found a surprise birthday party waiting, with a homemade cake.
A November 2024 regular watched the chef keep an eye on every guest while cooking, among business people, overseas visitors and the late-night crowd.
A November 2025 first-timer said the konjac with roe made other konjac sashimi seem lesser.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 楽食酒 我ん家、居酒屋・串揚げ・魚介料理、東山区祇園町北側347-68 クローバービル1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、火〜土 18:00〜翌4:00 (料理 L.O. 3:00、ドリンク L.O. 3:30)、日・月・祝日休み、付き出し350円、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、14席 (カウンター8、掘りごたつの個室6)、喫煙可、2015年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2025年、英語): 串カツ、串焼き、おでん、お造り、生牡蠣、とうもろこしの天ぷら、自家製の厚揚げ、自家製ドレッシングのサラダ、子持ちこんにゃく、大将と奥さんの夫婦で営む、料理長が替わり盛り付けが良くなった (2025年1月)、7時ごろは予約が必要。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter izakaya; many overseas guests (November 2024 review); smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through December 2025.

kyoto_gion_mishima_unagi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled eel on rice with a soy-based tare (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_mishima_unagi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_mishima_unagi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 11:30–15:30 (food L.O. 15:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–17:00 (food L.O. 16:30); closed Thursdays; may close early when the eel runs out; closed 14–15 August (Tabelog). Cashless payment only — cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 38 seats, private rooms (Tabelog). A renovated old building with a garden in the Gion tea-house district, 5 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
kyoto_gion_mishima_unagi.notes: [Unagi · Gion] The Gion branch of a Wakayama eel house, in a renovated old building with a garden: eel grilled over binchotan in Wakayama and finished here, served as unaju with soft rice. About ¥5,000–6,000; cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 October 2025 (Tabelog), with its main shop in Wakayama (April 2026 review). The eel is grilled over binchotan at the Wakayama shop and reheated in a steam oven in Kyoto (April 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner asked how the eel was cooked and learned it is grilled in Wakayama and steamed back to heat here — without any stale smell.
A Saturday-noon diner in August 2026 was seated at once and had the ¥5,500 momo unaju with umeboshi among the pickles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都･祇園 美しま、うなぎ、東山区祇園町南側570-161、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月・火・水・金 11:30〜15:30 (料理 L.O. 15:00)、土日祝日 11:30〜17:00 (料理 L.O. 16:30)、木曜休み、うなぎがなくなり次第早めに閉店、8月14・15日休み、キャッシュレスのみ、38席、個室、2025年10月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): Wakayama の本店で備長炭で焼きスチームオーブンで温める、皮はぱりっと身はふわっと、一尾のうな重、Momo unaju 5,500円、漬物に梅干し、たれは卓上、お茶屋街の古い建物を改装し庭がある。

cultural_comfort.note: Cashless only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated April–August 2026.

kyoto_gion_mishima_unagi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26043887/ (35.002701, 135.775849), 3.9 m from kyoto_gion_nishimura — moved 3 m south-west to (35.002682, 135.775826), 6.9 m clearance; GSI returns the 祇園町南側570 block point about 200 m away, so approximate; 2026-11-08

kyoto_gion_hayakawa_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki built on kombu and bonito dashi; soy sauce is likely (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_gion_hayakawa_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi of bonito flakes and seafood (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_hayakawa_honten.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; maiko and geiko can be invited for a tea-house evening (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 26 seats; private rooms (Tabelog). In south Gion, 7 min from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_hayakawa_honten.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Gion] A family-run Gion kaiseki house, about thirty years old, cooking certified seasonal Kyoto vegetables with a strong dashi, where you can invite maiko and geiko for an evening. About ¥10,000–20,000.

chef_bio.background: The okami is also the head chef; the owner is the okami's husband, and the original owner was the owner's mother; 31 years old as of August 2024 (August 2024 review). Recognised as a provider of seasonal Kyoto vegetables by the Kyoto Furusato Product Association (Tabelog). A June 2025 diner was told the Tedorigawa sake comes from the young owner's grandfather's brewery.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto vegetables and a careful dashi (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-vegetable kaiseki; tea-house evenings with maiko.

anecdotes.text: Planning a reception with maiko, geiko and performers, an August 2024 visitor came ahead to check the room and was charmed by the okami's Kyoto dialect.
On a second visit in June 2025, a light drinker spent the evening talking with the owner and liked the house sake "Hayakawa" and the Tedorigawa.
An October 2024 guest came at the invitation of a geisha.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: はやかわ 本店、日本料理・鍋、東山区祇園町南側570-164、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、毎日 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、26席、個室、季節の京野菜の会席とお茶屋の体験、Kamo なす・Shogoin かぶ・Tanba の松茸、昆布と鰹の出汁 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2020〜2025年、英語): 女将が料理長、主人は女将の夫で先代は主人の母、創業31年 (2024年8月)、舞妓・芸妓を呼べる、オリジナルの日本酒 "Hayakawa" と若主人の祖父の蔵の Tedorigawa (2025年6月)、出汁がしっかり。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ask about inviting maiko.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2025.

kyoto_ethnic_baru_tapas.gf_detail: Ask. Biryani and spice curries are rice-based, but fritters and sauces are unknown (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_ethnic_baru_tapas.vegan_detail: Ask. Spice dishes and curries change with the season; most known dishes use meat, seafood, egg or cheese (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_ethnic_baru_tapas.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–01:00 (L.O. 00:30); Sat 17:00–01:00 (L.O. 23:30); holidays and the day before 17:00–01:00; closed Sundays from January (Tabelog). Lunch started in 2026 (July 2026 review). One drink and two dishes per person (Tabelog Japanese original 「お一人様につき1ドリンク・2フード以上のご注文をお願いしております。」). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter, 6 in booths; private rooms (Tabelog). Down an alley off Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog; May–June 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ethnic_baru_tapas.notes: [Spice bar & curry · Kiyamachi] A small counter bar down an alley off Kiyamachi by a curry chef, serving creative Asian and ethnic small plates, seasonal biryani and spice curries late into the night, with curry lunches on weekdays. About ¥2,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 21 October 2025 (Tabelog) by a curry chef already popular for curry in a shared kitchen (October 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A first-week diner in October 2025 and again in October 2026 found the biryani and spice curry to finish unforgettable.
A June 2026 diner after work had the five-kind appetizer platter and the ¥1,700 salted-pork biryani with an Akaboshi beer.
A July 2026 lunch diner tried the new lunch, mixing squid-ink and mustard-scallop curries.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: エスニックバル タパス、アジア・エスニック・バル、中京区恵比須町446 葵センター104、京都市役所前駅から徒歩2分、月〜金 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:30)、土 17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 23:30)、祝日と祝日の前日 17:00〜翌1:00、1月から毎週日曜休み、1人1ドリンク・2フード以上、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、14席 (カウンター8、ボックス6)、個室、2025年10月21日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 間借りのカレーで人気の料理人の店、季節のビリヤニとスパイスカレー、イカスミのビリヤニ、塩豚のビリヤニのプレート1,700円、前菜5種盛り1,000円、季節のフルーツと生ハムのカプレーゼ1,000円、牛タンのカルパッチョ、gai yang、ヤングコーンのフリット、昼のカレー (イカスミ、マスタードと帆立、バターチキン1,200円)、芋焼酎、LIBROM。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter bar; order at least one drink and two dishes.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_arfa_cafe_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pizza, pasta, baguette snacks, gratin and waffles (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_arfa_cafe_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheese fondue, cream gratin and pasta, prosciutto, bacon (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_arfa_cafe_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 (last orders food 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 17:00–0:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closures; private hire outside hours by phone (Tabelog). No service or cover charge; one drink per person (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料、チャージ料なし。ワンドリンク制」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 31 seats, up to 40 standing; private rooms for 2–8 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). USEN.X Kiyamachi 5F, Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, with big windows over the city (Tabelog; November 2024). Opened 1 August 2008 (Tabelog).
kyoto_arfa_cafe_sanjo.notes: [Dining bar · Sanjo-Kiyamachi, since 2008] A fifth-floor dining bar with large windows over the Kiyamachi night view, popular for birthdays and parties: pizza, pasta, cheese fondue and gratins, courses with all-you-can-drink and a heart-shaped surprise cake. Open for lunch and until midnight; no cover charge, one drink each.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining bar opened in August 2008 on the fifth floor of a building on Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, available for private hire.

anecdotes.text: An April 2024 diner celebrated with the ¥2,200 lunch birthday course and its heart-shaped cake.
A November 2024 diner ordered baguette snacks at ¥100 each and admired the night view from the big windows.
A January 2026 guest pulled off a surprise for a friend with the Standard PARTY course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・カフェ、中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比寿町534-31 USEN.X 木屋町 5F、地下鉄京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、毎日12:00〜15:00 と17:00〜24:00、不定休、サービス料・チャージなし (ワンドリンク制)、カード可、31席 (立食40名)、個室、禁煙、2008年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2017年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 誕生日のコースとハートのケーキ、ランチの誕生日コース2,200円、ピザとパスタ、グラタン、アヒージョ、バゲット1本100円から、チーズフォンデュ、ワッフル、飲み放題、5階の窓からの夜景。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course for celebrations; one drink per person. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_fugu_matsu.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled fugu can be seasoned with olive oil, sesame oil or soy sauce (2024 reviews); ponzu and zosui also appear; no gluten information.
kyoto_gion_fugu_matsu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fugu restaurant (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_fugu_matsu.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Sunday and the second Monday; may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 seats at tables for 2–6; private room (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Amica Building 2, 1F, Gion north side, 6 min from Gion-Shijo exit 7 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_fugu_matsu.notes: [Fugu · Gion] A Gion fugu restaurant whose signature is yaki-fugu, grilled at the table and seasoned as you like — olive oil is the regulars’ favourite, or sesame oil or soy sauce — with courses up to eight fugu dishes, hot pot with ponzu, grilled shirako and zosui. Children welcome. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a fugu restaurant on the north side of Gion, reviewed since December 2022, known for grilled fugu with a choice of seasonings.

anecdotes.text: A regular since 2024 brought a son, who was so taken with it as to want to return alone (October 2025).
A December 2024 diner was grateful the kitchen made dishes it normally skips at busy times.
A January 2024 visitor added grilled skin to an eight-dish course because the olive-oil fugu was that good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ふぐ・日本料理、東山区祇園町北側282-6 アミカビル2 1F、京阪祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩約6分、月〜土・祝日18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、日曜と第2月曜休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、24席、個室、禁煙、子ども可。口コミ (2022年12月〜2026年5月、英語): 焼きふぐ (オリーブオイル・ごま油・醤油から選べる)、焼きふぐ・八坂・祇園の3コースとアラカルト、ふぐ8品、皮の焼き、雑炊、ふぐのわさび、ポン酢の鍋、白子焼き、出汁茶漬け、白ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose the grilled-fugu seasoning (olive oil, sesame oil or soy sauce). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_setsugekka_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. A bar with homemade chocolates, fruit platters and desserts (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_setsugekka_sanjo.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit platters and fruit juices (June 2025; September 2026); the chocolates and cakes are unconfirmed; no vegan information.
kyoto_setsugekka_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 19:00–2:00; open all year; check for changes (Tabelog). Charge ¥500 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「チャージ料500円（ シガー販売）」); a July 2025 diner paid an ¥800 cover. Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 58 seats across counter, tables, a tatami room, raised private rooms for 4–12 and a cigar room (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). SACRA Building B1F and 1F, Sanjo-dori west of Tominokoji — a Taisho-era former bank, a registered tangible cultural property (Tabelog; June and August 2025). Basement floor open at weekends (April 2026).
kyoto_setsugekka_sanjo.notes: [Cigar and whisky bar · Sanjo, in a Taisho-era bank] A bar, said to be family-run, inside the SACRA building, a Taisho-era former bank on Sanjo-dori, with themed rooms named Snow, Moon and Flower, a cigar room and a long counter. Whiskies, original cocktails and non-alcoholic drinks, with homemade chocolate plates and fruit. Open every night to 2:00; smoking allowed; small cover charge.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a bar in the SACRA building, formerly a Kyoto branch of a mutual savings bank built in the early Taisho era and now a registered tangible cultural property; a September 2026 visitor describes it as family-run.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular was shown to the "Moon" room on a second visit to the bar’s four themed spaces.
An April 2026 visitor notes a separate cigar-bar floor and a basement opened at weekends.
A January 2026 guest relaxed with a cigar and the homemade chocolate plate.

kyoto_omi_gyu_shinagawatei.notes: [Omi beef · Nishiki Market, a butcher's croquettes and sukiyaki] The Kyoto counter of a family Omi-beef butcher from Otsu, a step south of Nishiki Market. Grab a freshly fried Omi-beef croquette (about ¥250) on the bench outside, or take off your shoes in the small back room for a ¥4,300 Omi-beef sukiyaki set. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The official site says two brothers from Kakamigahara, Gifu, founded the butcher 品川亭総本店 in Kyoto in the Taisho era; the younger, 遠藤芳男, first of this line, opened 品川亭精肉店 in Hamaotsu, and the shop still stands by Mii-dera Station in Otsu. The Kyoto shop opened in May 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: To share the taste of Omi beef chosen by the owner, with a butcher’s eye for good meat (official site).

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 lunch guest took shoes off in the back tatami room, where everyone was eating sukiyaki.
A July 2024 visitor noted the croquette costs ¥248 here against ¥165, cash only, at the Otsu main shop.
A May 2025 food-lover burned a mouth a little on a croquette straight from the fryer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 近江牛 品川亭 京都店、錦市場・柳馬場通を少し南に下ったところ、営業時間11:30〜18:00、水曜定休、京都店限定の近江牛ロースすき焼き定食4,300円・近江牛ロース牛丼定食2,200円 (税込)、店内奥の座敷、揚げたての近江牛コロッケと串カツ、A5・A4等級の近江牛ロースを販売。大正時代、岐阜県各務原の兄弟が京都・東洞院五条上ルで精肉店「品川亭総本店」を創業、弟の当店初代遠藤芳男が大津・浜大津で「品川亭精肉店」を開業、京阪三井寺駅前の大津本店。食べログ: コロッケ・すき焼き・牛料理、京都市中京区中魚屋町478、月火木〜日 11:30〜18:30、水曜定休、カード・QR可、2022年5月15日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2025年、英語): 近江牛コロッケ245〜248円 (大津本店は165円で現金のみ)、揚げたてで5分待ち、店の外のベンチで、奥の座敷ですき焼きと牛丼のランチ、精算機でカード可、気さくな店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Butcher’s counter; cards and QR at a payment machine.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2025.

kyoto_gion_shoga_gyoza_suzucho.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-wrapper gyoza; oden includes fish cakes and chikuwa (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_gion_shoga_gyoza_suzucho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork gyoza and a Kanto-style oden broth (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_gion_shoga_gyoza_suzucho.hours_raw: 18:00–03:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). A November 2025 reviewer booked a lunch sitting, which Tabelog does not list — check. Reservations taken; recommended at weekends (September 2025). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). QR or mobile ordering (2026 reviews). 22 seats: a U-shaped counter round the oden pot, and private rooms; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2026). Down to the basement under pink neon, in a building above Nawate-Shinbashi, 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_gion_shoga_gyoza_suzucho.notes: [Gyoza & oden · Gion near Shinbashi, till 3 am] A neon-pink basement bar off Nawate where a U-shaped counter rings a pot of Kanto-style oden. The draw is the ginger gyoza (¥500 a plate) — Kujo onion, Kyoto pork and lots of ginger — with oden at ¥300 a piece and beef-tendon stew. Open to 3 am; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in October 2023 (Tabelog). The shop describes ginger gyoza and Kanto-style oden made to go with sake (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a lively basement counter with young staff.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 couple dropped in late after a gathering at a Gion tea house, for beef-tendon fried rice and gyoza.
A March 2026 diner who cannot usually eat ginger still loved the ginger gyoza and the mochi kinchaku.
A February 2026 pair found every plate quietly cut in half for sharing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園生姜餃子 鈴兆、餃子・おでん・居酒屋、京都市東山区西之町216-2 縄手新橋大西ビルB1F、京阪祇園四条駅・三条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00、日曜定休、予約可、カード可、電子マネー不可、22席、個室あり、禁煙、2023年10月2日オープン、九条ねぎと京都の豚とたっぷりの生姜の生姜餃子、U字のカウンターの真ん中に関東風のおでん。メニュー (2024年): 名物生姜餃子・にんにく餃子・水餃子500円、おでん各300円、おまかせ5種1,200円、牛すじ煮込み800円、唐揚げ800円、里芋の唐揚げ800円、やみつききゅうり500円、白菜と長芋のキムチ500円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ピンクのネオン、QRで注文、牛すじチャーハン800円、細麺の焼きそば、餅巾着、週末は予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; cards accepted; open late.

kyoto_crepe_atelier_butter.gf_detail: Not GF: crisp wheat crêpes; galettes are listed but buckwheat content is not published (reviews).
kyoto_crepe_atelier_butter.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter-and-sugar crêpes with cream and gelato (reviews).
kyoto_crepe_atelier_butter.hours_raw: 13:00–21:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash-free QR payment; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Order downstairs; about four counter seats there, and an eat-in room upstairs with a one-drink rule (2026 reviews). Takeaway too (June 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the corner of Gokomachi and Rokkaku (February 2026).
kyoto_crepe_atelier_butter.notes: [Crêpes · Gokomachi-Rokkaku, sugar and butter] A small crêpe shop on a Gokomachi corner making crisp, waffle-cone-like crêpes spread with real butter and crunchy sugar — salted bitter caramel (¥700) or cream cheese and rum raisin. Eat at the tiny counter, upstairs, or on the go. 13:00–21:00 daily; QR payment only.

chef_bio.background: Opened in March 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2026) describe a sugar-butter crêpe specialist with a crisp batter, an ordering counter downstairs and a cat-illustrated eat-in room upstairs.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 guest watched a block of butter spread straight onto the crêpe.
A November 2026 visitor tried Uji-matcha batter for the first time, crunchy as a waffle.
An October 2026 thrift-shop browser found the classic sugar butter far sweeter than expected.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: crêpe atelier .Butter、クレープ・ガレット、京都市中京区八百屋町112-3、毎日13:00〜21:00、カード・電子マネー不可、QR可、禁煙、2025年3月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 御幸町六角の角、シュガーバタークレープの専門店、パリパリの生地、バターのかたまりと粗糖、塩ビターキャラメル700円、クリームチーズとラムレーズン750円、ココナッツアーモンド750円、カスタード追加200円、シナモンシュガー、りんごシナモンバニラ、宇治抹茶の生地、ジェラートのトッピング、ガレットも少し、カフェラテ350円、1階で注文、カウンター4席ほど、2階はイートイン (ワンドリンク制、猫のイラスト)、テイクアウトも。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; QR payment only.

kyoto_coffee_wine_violon.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee, wine, cheese, penne and chocolate gâteau; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_coffee_wine_violon.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee and wine; the signature cream soda has rose-shaped ice cream, and snacks run to cheese (reviews).
kyoto_coffee_wine_violon.hours_raw: 17:00–01:00 Monday–Wednesday, Friday and Saturday; 18:00–01:00 Thursday; Sunday is not given in Tabelog’s hours, so it is left out; hours vary by day and may change (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). A small counter only; non-smoking; classical music (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Hard to find: behind an iron door at the back of the mixed-use building near Matsubara bridge, like a flat entrance (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_wine_violon.notes: [Night café & wine · near Matsubara bridge, behind an iron door] A hidden counter café-bar behind an unmarked iron door at the back of a building near Matsubara bridge: a sommelier owner pours well-chosen wines and daily-roasted coffee, and makes a famous blue cream soda crowned with a rose of ice cream (¥1,600). Classical music; open to 1 am.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2022–2026) describe a quiet counter café and wine bar hidden in a mixed-use building near Matsubara bridge, run by a gentle owner who is also a sommelier.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 visitor had long passed the iron door without daring to open it.
A May 2025 guest finally came for the rose cream soda after a year of wanting to, and stayed for penne and wine.
A February 2024 night stroller, after dinner at the Fauchon Hotel, was given hot water with the cream soda on a cold evening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒー&ワイン ヴィオロン、カフェ・ワインバー、京都市下京区清水町297-1 すえひろビル1F奥、月〜水・金・土 17:00〜翌1:00、木 18:00〜翌1:00 (日曜の時間の記載なし)、曜日で異なる、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、カウンターのみ、禁煙。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 松原橋の近く、雑居ビルの奥の鉄の扉、隠れ家、ソムリエでもある店主、日替わりの自家焙煎コーヒー、店主が選んだワインとチーズ、青いソーダに薔薇の形のアイスのクリームソーダ1,600円 (2025年) とお湯、ペンネ、ガトーショコラ、クラシック音楽、鳥の形の紙のカトラリー置き。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; quiet; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_kyo_kurara.gf_detail: Not GF: everything is made of nama-fu, which is wheat gluten (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kyo_kurara.vegan_detail: Ask. Nama-fu with white or red miso, kinako or sweet-potato filling may be plant-based, but some versions are wrapped in bacon (December 2025; September 2026).
kyoto_gion_kyo_kurara.hours_raw: Takeaway only — a street-side stall, with somewhere nearby to sit (June 2026). Monday–Friday 11:00–17:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:00–18:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (AMEX), e-money and QR (Tabelog). Grilled to order, about 5–10 minutes, with a number ticket (2026 reviews). Directly opposite Yasaka Shrine; busy at weekends (April 2026). Opened 13 March 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kyo_kurara.notes: [Nama-fu snacks · opposite Yasaka Shrine, takeaway] A tiny stall grilling chewy Kyoto nama-fu to order — miso dengaku, "aburi fu" with sweet miso and kinako, colourful skewers and sweet-filled versions — to eat as you walk. Wait about 10 minutes with a number; some find it pricey. Not for coeliacs: fu is wheat gluten.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a small take-out shop opened 13 March 2019 specialising in Kyoto-style nama-fu, directly across from Yasaka Shrine (2025–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 walker, finding the aburi-mochi shop shut, came here for nama-fu with sweet white miso, ¥400 for four.
A December 2025 regular passes the Yasaka Shrine crossing and cannot resist the warm sweet-potato and strawberry fu.
An August 2026 visitor waited ten minutes with a number tag for the aburi fu, liked it, but thought it a bit pricey.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和菓子・甘味処、東山区祇園町北側294、祇園四条から489m、月〜金 11:00〜17:00、土・日・祝日 11:00〜18:00、予約不可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、2019年3月13日開店、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 八坂神社の真向かいの京生麩の持ち帰りの店、注文後に焼く (5〜10分、番号札)、白味噌・赤味噌の田楽、甘い味噌ときなこの炙り麩4本400円、三色の串、ぶぶあられの揚げ麩、紫芋やいちごのあん、ベーコン巻き、近くに座れる場所、週末は混む、高めとの声、店員がそっけなかったとの声 (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway stall; order and wait with a number; cards (AMEX), IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_toridokoro_ooharaya.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken soup, sashimi and salt-grilled wings may be wheat-free, but there are noodles, fried tsukune and sweet sauces; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toridokoro_ooharaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken specialist (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toridokoro_ooharaya.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:30; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 9 at the counter, tables for 2–8, one tatami room (Tabelog). Some seats allow smoking (Tabelog). Basement of the MIYUKI building on the east side of Kiyamachi south of Oike; 5 min walk north from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_toridokoro_ooharaya.notes: [Chicken · Kiyamachi-Oike, basement] A small, calm basement counter run by a couple, where a hotel-trained owner serves chicken every way: oyakodon and kamo nanban lunch sets that start with a clear chicken soup, and at night chicken sashimi, salt-grilled wings and mizutaki. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a chicken specialist run by a couple (August 2023), the owner bringing an impressive hotel background (February 2024), in a tidy basement on Kiyamachi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2023 guest, who phoned on the off-chance and got a table, found the owner working alone that night but serving everything efficiently.
A February 2026 Kyoto Marathon runner had kamo nanban heaped with Kujo negi and a rich-yolked tamago kake gohan for lunch.
A September 2026 diner on the Nishiyama course began with chicken broth, then breast, gizzard and liver sashimi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鶏料理・焼き鳥・水炊き、中京区木屋町通御池下る上大阪町515 MIYUKIビル B1F、京阪三条駅から木屋町を北へ5分、月〜水・金〜日 11:30〜14:00、17:00〜21:30、木曜休み、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、16席 (カウンター9、テーブル8、座敷1)、一部喫煙可、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2023年2月〜2026年11月、英語): 夫婦で営む (2023年8月)、ホテル出身の店主 (2024年2月)、昼は鶏スープ付きの親子丼、焼き鳥丼、鶏南蛮うどん、九条ねぎの鴨南蛮、卵かけご飯、夜は Nishiyama コース (ささみ・砂肝・レバーの刺身、蒸し鶏、手羽の塩焼き、つくねの揚げ物)、鶏の鍋、地下でわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Small basement counter; book for dinner; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_onigiri_hatsuki.gf_detail: Ask. A plain salt onigiri is rice, salt and nori, but fillings such as tuna mayo, bento toppings and grilled onigiri may contain soy or wheat; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onigiri_hatsuki.vegan_detail: Ask. A salt onigiri with nori is plant-based; check the miso soup's dashi and each filling (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onigiri_hatsuki.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 9:00–17:00; Sunday 9:00–15:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Order and pay at the register first; eat in or take away — the nori differs between the two (April 2025). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). In the former Eitaro site, a few metres west of Daimaru Kyoto; 2 min walk from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; April 2025). Opened 24 March 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_onigiri_hatsuki.notes: [Onigiri · Nishiki-Karasuma, from 9 a.m.] A bright onigiri shop near Daimaru that opens at 9, making some forty rice balls from premium Niigata rice and Ariake nori — from plain salt to salmon butter and yuzu-takana tuna mayo — to eat in with miso soup or take away. Order and pay first. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: an onigiri specialist opened 24 March 2025 in the former Eitaro site near Shijo-Karasuma, using 100% Niigata "Shinnosuke" rice and Ariake Sea nori, with attentive staff (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: The rice and the nori are the stars (March 2025).

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor explained the system: order and pay at the register first, and the nori differs for eating in and taking away.
A December 2025 guest had the cute "bento" onigiri with octopus sausage and an aosa miso soup set, touched by the staff's care.
An August 2026 diner noted the onigiri are about ¥400 each and the miso set ¥300, and might skip the set with a pricier filling.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おにぎり、中京区元法然寺町683 烏丸錦ビル 1F、四条駅・烏丸駅から徒歩2分、火〜土 9:00〜17:00、日 9:00〜15:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テイクアウト、2025年3月24日開店。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年9月、英語): 新潟の「Shinnosuke」と有明海の海苔のおにぎり専門店、以前は Eitaro の場所、最初にレジで注文と会計、店内と持ち帰りで海苔が違う (2025年4月)、約40種類、鮭390円、塩、焼きおにぎり、季節の鮭バター、柚子高菜とツナマヨ440円、たこさんウインナーなどの弁当おにぎり、味噌汁セット +250〜300円、あおさの味噌汁、ていねいな接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay first; eat in or take away; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_teppan_stand_pokupoku.gf_detail: Not GF: gyoza and teppan dishes with soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_stand_pokupoku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork-steak teppan bar (2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_stand_pokupoku.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–23:30 (last orders food 22:30, drinks 23:00); closing days vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — not to be confused with other shops in the building; two-person bookings may be given a wall standing table (Tabelog; August 2026). Table seat charge ¥360, none at the standing counter or with the Pokupoku salad or a course (Tabelog original 立飲み席は頂いておりません。テーブル席のみお席料金360円頂戴しております。※ぽくぽーくサラダのご提供・コースご利用の場合は頂いておりません。). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 66 places: 58 at tables, 8 standing (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Wisteria building 2F, by the Daimaru car park; 4 min walk from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 February 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_stand_pokupoku.notes: [Teppan bar · Nishiki-Karasuma, 2F] A busy, cheap standing-and-table bar opened in 2026, famous for thick pork steaks grilled on the teppan with truffle soy sauce, plus small plates and ¥100 lemon sours. Tables carry a ¥360 seat charge; the standing counter does not. Smoking allowed; can be cramped and slow when full.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a teppan standing bar opened 26 February 2026 near Daimaru Kyoto, popular from the start for pork steak; an April 2026 reviewer took it to be a sister of a restaurant called Fuhufu.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 trio of women shared the 350 g "Rookie" pork steak and were surprised by the ¥100 lemon sour.
An August 2026 pair who had booked were put at a narrow wall standing table, the only option for two, and held back on ordering.
A September 2026 solo drinker found the pork steak fattier than expected and was unsure about returning.

A June 2024 diner arriving before 19:00 found every seat, counter included, already taken.

kyoto_chubo_dan_kiyamachi.notes: [Iron-pot izakaya · Kiyamachi, to 4 am] A fifth-floor izakaya off Kiyamachi with night views and late hours, built around Dan-yaki — beef, pork and chicken simmered under a heap of vegetables in a sweet-spicy iron pot, finished with udon — plus chijimi, spicy tripe and rare draft beers such as Sorachi. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened in December 2022 on Kiyamachi, with Dan-yaki as its signature and beers chosen by the owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Dan-yaki iron-pot dish; craft and rare beers.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner learned the Sorachi draft is poured in only two places in Kyoto.
A July 2024 visitor liked the roomy interior, the dashimaki and ajillo, and cold noodles to finish.
A June 2026 first-timer came after work, glad it stays open into the small hours.

Service charge 10% plus a ¥1,100 charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料１０％ チャージ1,100円」). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). kyoto_fellow_and_fellow_gion.notes: [Whisky bar · Gion, since 1991] A long-established fourth-floor bar on the north side of Gion, run by a couple, with whisky (including its own 25th-anniversary bottling), classic cocktails, an expanded food menu, kiseru pipes to try and beer festivals a few times a year. Regulars keep personal beer mugs behind the bar. ¥1,100 charge plus 10% service; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar opened in February 1991 in Gion; a March 2026 visitor returning after about 20 years was looked after by the master’s wife.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor returning after some 20 years found the grand piano gone but the bar still nostalgic, and toasted with the 25th-anniversary whisky.
A September 2026 regular started with draft beer from a mug kept behind the bar, then an Old Fashioned and a Martini.
A July 2026 regular came for one of the beer festivals held a few times a year, with free-flow Sapporo Classic and a tasting of tofu from four old Kyoto makers.

kyoto_shinsa_kokkedan_shijo.notes: [Korean soy-marinated crab · Shijo-Karasuma, since 2025] The Kyoto branch of a Seoul blue-crab specialist, serving rich ganjang gejang — finished by mixing rice into the crab shell — spicy yangnyeom crab, soft-shell crab jjigae, marinated shrimp, yukhoe and jeon. Lunch sets around ¥4,500 with free side refills; big sets for groups. QR ordering; private rooms.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: the Kyoto Shijo-Karasuma shop, opened November 2025, of a Seoul blue-crab restaurant (reviews name Sinsa-dong and Sinchon); Tabelog lists two more Shinsa Kokkedan shops in Osaka.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 early arrival was invited in out of the heat to wait at the table while a big crab delivery came in.
A July 2026 repeat visitor learned that eight shrimp were plenty for two after over-ordering the first time.
A September 2026 diner mixed the crab roe left in the shell with rice into a bibimbap.

kyoto_yakiniku_horumon_mansei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu and offal (horumon) yakiniku house; kimchi and cold noodles are the only non-meat dishes reviewers name (2026).
kyoto_yakiniku_horumon_mansei.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00). Reservations taken; Saturday opening was full by 17:00 (July 2026). Cover 「チャージ料300円」 (Tabelog Japanese original; a September 2026 reviewer paid ¥330 incl. tax). 100 seats, including a counter, tatami rooms on the 2nd floor and summer riverside seats on the Kamo River noryo-yuka (no smoking there); private hire for 20–50. Designated smoking area. Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR. English menu. Children welcome. Wheelchair accessible. At the end of the Kamiyashiya bridge (as a September 2026 reviewer spells it) off Kiyamachi, just north of Sanjo; 5 min from Keihan Sanjo. Opened 6 January 2022. Operator 株式会社ORIZON BLUE PARTNERS (NTA invoice register).
kyoto_yakiniku_horumon_mansei.notes: [Yakiniku & horumon · Kiyamachi on the Kamo River, a lantern-lit riverside grill] A lively, good-value yakiniku house by the Sanjo bridges — wagyu, tongue flights and a long list of offal, dipped Kyoto-style in a light daikon broth — with fresh kimchi and cold noodles, and riverside seats on the summer yuka. About ¥5,000–8,000 a head. ¥300 cover.

roles: Operator: 株式会社ORIZON BLUE PARTNERS (NTA invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 January 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe numerous young staff — some of them high-school students, a November 2026 reviewer learned — who were friendly and attentive, a crowd of students and tourists, and signed celebrity photos on the walls. Criticism: rice served long before the meat on a busy night (July 2026), small insects at the riverside seats early in the evening (August 2026), and very large portions on courses (July and November 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Horumon and wagyu yakiniku with Kyoto-style arai-dare; fresh kimchi.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "The horumon and fatty cuts are perfectly finished with a refreshing Kyoto-style 'Arai-dare' sauce! Dipping the meat into the broth with grated daikon makes it even more delicious."
August 2026: "I was seated right by the river, and it was a delight to enjoy Yakiniku while watching people leisurely stroll or sit by the riverside."

kyoto_mannaka_higashinotoin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an izakaya menu of kara-age, kushikatsu, tempura, handmade gyoza and kimchi chige with ramen (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_mannaka_higashinotoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, chicken wings, pork kimchi, oden with egg (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_mannaka_higashinotoin.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sunday and holidays. Reservations taken. No credit cards; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 24 seats: 5 at the counter, tatami and tables; private hire up to 20. Smoking allowed, so under-20s are not admitted (Tabelog). 2nd floor of the ロイヤルプラザビル at the southeast corner of Higashinotoin and Rokkaku; 7 min walk from Karasuma, Shijo or Karasuma-Oike stations. A 2016 reviewer says it moved here from Muromachi, under a different name, about ten years earlier.
kyoto_mannaka_higashinotoin.notes: [Izakaya · Higashinotoin-Rokkaku near Rokkakudo, a landlady's second-floor local] A cozy, smoke-friendly second-floor izakaya in the very middle of Kyoto: daily fish, obanzai, oden, sweet chicken wings and a good run of local sake, poured to overflowing by a warm landlady. About ¥3,000–5,000. Smoking allowed; adults only. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; called the landlady by a November 2025 reviewer)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2007 describe a homely, calm izakaya; an October 2011 reviewer mentions the owner and, apparently, her son, and a November 2025 reviewer the warm landlady who pours sake until it overflows. A 2016 reviewer says it moved from Muromachi-dori, under a different name, about ten years before. The name comes from the Heso-ishi stone at Rokkakudo (Chohoji), the symbolic centre of Kyoto (Tabelog). Criticism: food slows when it is busy (2011); a 2007 reviewer found the seasoning a little sweet; smoking is allowed.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily fish; obanzai; oden; local sake.

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "When I ordered Japanese sake, they poured it generously until it overflowed from the cup, which was a delightful traditional touch. The friendly conversations with the warm owner made for a relaxing and enjoyable experience."
December 2024: "The Japanese radish is incredibly delicious, soaked well in the broth… Please note that this place allows smoking."

Cards, iD and QR. 25 seats: 9 at the counter, 16 in a tatami room (low tables, not sunken); private room. Heated tobacco only; an outdoor ashtray for cigarettes. Children welcome, with a kids' menu. Staff spoke English (August 2026). 1 min walk from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo. Opened 10 April 2024. Run by 合同会社Rmeet (NTA invoice register; rmeet-kyoto.com).
kyoto_aji_no_mise_kyowasai.notes: [Steamed yoshoku izakaya · by Kiyomizu-Gojo Station, a counter and tatami room] A friendly late-night spot a minute from Kiyomizu-Gojo that steams its roast beef, hamburg and vegetables in seiro baskets, with seasonal pastas and cutlets; about ¥4,000–8,000. English-speaking staff. Open to midnight; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 April 2024 (Tabelog). Operated by 合同会社Rmeet, whose site says the company began with ロジオク, a roast-beef restaurant born during the pandemic (rmeet-kyoto.com). Reviewers describe kind, attentive staff and regulars. Criticism: a September 2026 reviewer found the roast beef tough for the price and the fried rice too strongly seasoned; an August 2026 reviewer with a tatami booking was seated at the counter, and the course differed from the Tabelog description.
chef_bio.specialty: Steamed roast beef; seiro-steamed vegetables; seasonal pasta.

anecdotes.text: November 2024: "I had no idea steamed dishes could be this delicious! … But the true highlight of this restaurant is the pasta!"
August 2026: "Most of the customers in the restaurant were foreigners, and the staff provided excellent service in English, which was impressive."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 味の店 京は菜、居酒屋・イタリアン・洋食、東山区宮川筋8-423-2、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩1分、月・火・木〜日・祝日17:30〜24:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.23:30)、水曜休み、年末年始休み、予約可、カード・iD・QR可、25席 (カウンター9・座敷16)、個室あり、加熱式たばこのみ (紙巻きは屋外に灰皿)、子供可・キッズメニューあり、2024年4月10日オープン、公式サイト rmeet-kyoto.com (合同会社Rmeet、ロジオクから始まった会社)。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 野菜のせいろ蒸し1,380円、豚のポッサム1,280円、ローストビーフ2,500円、焼き飯1,580円 (2026年9月)、ハンバーグのコース5,500円 (2026年8月)、蒸しハンバーグ、蒸しパスタ、デミオムレツ、カツ、プリン、conger eelとたこの夏のパスタ、明太チーズのチキンカツ、ネックのペペロンチーノ、鹿肉のソーセージ、飲み放題のコース、英語での接客 (2026年8月)、ローストビーフが硬い・焼き飯が濃いとの声 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff served in English (August 2026); counter and tatami room.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August, September and October 2026.

kyoto_la_princesse.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: white omurice with a red-wine demi sauce (or a spice-curry version), fig mille-feuille and chocolate desserts (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_la_princesse.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omurice of white-yolk eggs with Parmigiano and a sauce of veal, lamb and red wine; oyster-flavored rice (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_la_princesse.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00; closed on irregular days; a café course runs 13:00–15:30 (August 2026 review). Reservations taken. Cards and PayPay. 30 seats with private rooms for 2–8; private hire for 20–50. Non-smoking. Pets welcome (in a carrier if other guests are present). Children welcome, with baby mats and children's cutlery (May 2026). 2nd floor of the Royal Plaza building at the southeast corner of Rokkaku and Higashinotoin, above a tantanmen shop; 5 min walk from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog). Opened 1 December 2020.
kyoto_la_princesse.notes: [Princess-theme café · Higashinotoin-Rokkaku, white omurice under a tiara] An antique-filled second-floor room where you can borrow a tiara and eat a strikingly white omurice crowned with a little crown, with fig mille-feuille and jam-sweetened cold-brew tea; lunch sets ¥2,000–2,700. Dogs welcome. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 December 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe antique furniture, Renoir paintings, violins and tiaras to borrow for photos, friendly staff and a crowd of birthday parties, girls' lunches and some men. Criticism: hard to find (August 2026); a modest-looking portion (June 2026).

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "When the White Omurice arrived, I was surprised by how incredibly white it was—much whiter than I had imagined."
September 2026: "Crowns and tiaras are available for free rental, allowing you to wear them for memorable photos during your celebration."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: la princesse kyoto、フレンチ・バル・イタリアン、中京区御射山町260 ロイヤルプラザビル2F、地下鉄烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分 (六角通と東洞院通の交差点の南東角、1階は担々麺店とカフェ)、毎日12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、カード・PayPay可、30席、個室 (2〜8名)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、ペット可 (他の客がいる時はケージで)、子供可、2020年12月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 白い卵とパルミジャーノの白いオムライス1,320円 (2024年8月)、スパイスカレー版、白いオムライスのセットA 2,000円・B 2,400円・C 2,700円、いちじくのミルフィーユ、チョコレートのグラサージュ、ジャム入りの水出し紅茶、北海道の仔牛の誕生日ランチ3,300円、夜は牡蠣とクラフトビール、アンティークの内装、ティアラの貸し出し、犬も可、場所がわかりにくいとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Pets and children welcome; tiaras to borrow for photos.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August and September 2026.

kyoto_poisson_dor_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Burgers, sandwiches, scones, omurice and cakes; no gluten-free options are reported (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_poisson_dor_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, rolled tonkatsu, puddings and cheesecakes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_poisson_dor_sanjo.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun, holidays and the days around them 11:00–19:00 (food L.O. 18:00, drinks 18:30); closed Tuesdays, Wednesdays and over New Year (Tabelog). A September 2026 review mentions an evening course of Kyoto–French food, which Tabelog's hours do not cover. Bookings taken; groups of 10 or more by phone; anniversary plates two days ahead (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 31 seats: 10 at the counter, 21 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). 3rd floor of the エアポートビル north of Sanjo on Kawaramachi, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog).
kyoto_poisson_dor_sanjo.notes: [Café · Kawaramachi-Sanjo] A third-floor café where goldfish swim in the table tops, serving pretty "dollhouse" lunch sets, hamburg steak and omurice, parfaits and cheesecakes, with a cheap drink bar. About ¥1,500–3,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 October 2024 (Tabelog); formerly the "Kyoto Goldfish Café Pukupuku no Mori" (November 2025 review). Described as supervised by a renowned French chef (2025–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 holiday diner booked ahead for the ¥2,500 dollhouse, chose its colour, and found the buns fluffy and the pudding good — more than just cute.
A July 2026 business traveller dining alone found the goldfish table kept any awkwardness away, and the burgers and sandwiches came warm.
An August 2026 pair found the taste and price average but expected it to be a big hit with women.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ポワソンドール、フレンチ・カフェ、中京区河原町通三条上る恵比須町534-33 エアポートビル3F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月・木〜日・祝日・祝日の前日・祝日の翌日 11:00〜19:00 (料理 L.O. 18:00、ドリンク L.O. 18:30)、火・水曜と年末年始休み、予約可 (10名以上は電話、記念日プレートは2日前まで)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、31席 (カウンター10、テーブル21)、禁煙、2024年10月23日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): テーブルの水槽に金魚、色を選べるドールハウスのランチ2,500円 (飲み物付きで200円引き)、デミグラスのハンバーグ、オムライス、巻きとんかつ、ほうじ茶パフェ、プリン、バスクチーズケーキ、酒粕のチーズケーキ、900円のドリンクバー、16種類の茶葉、有名なフランス料理のシェフ監修、旧名は Kyoto Goldfish Café Pukupuku no Mori。

cultural_comfort.note: Book at weekends (September 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_beerman_shijo_karasuma.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a beer bar; dishes include fried chicken and other batter (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_beerman_shijo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: jerk chicken, roast pork, duck ham, steak (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_beerman_shijo_karasuma.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); irregular closures; Sunday hours are not given (Tabelog). Bookings taken; groups of 20 and private hire (2025–26 reviews). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 34 seats, a private room for 4 and a semi-private banquet room; smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2025 review). 2nd floor of フォーラム四条烏丸, set back from the road, 5 min from Karasuma exit 21 (Tabelog; 2022 and 2025 reviews).
kyoto_beerman_shijo_karasuma.notes: [Craft beer · Shijo-Karasuma] A spacious second-floor beer bar by Nishiki Market with four drafts, thirty-odd European bottles and rooms for work parties; all-you-can-drink courses include craft beer. About ¥3,000–6,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 26 February 2018 (Tabelog). A manager passionate about Belgian and German beer who explains the differences (2021–2022 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 group of twenty booked the ¥5,500 all-you-can-drink course, with a craft-beer coupon for the toast, and liked the jerk chicken and bibimbap.
A March 2026 second-stop visitor booked through Tabelog at the last minute and poured a Delirium first tasted in Belgium.
A June 2026 group took a five-beer course in a private room, with DAY DREAM and THE STONE WALL on the guest taps.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BeerMan、ダイニングバー・ビアバー・居酒屋、中京区西魚屋町607 フォーラム四条烏丸2F、阪急烏丸駅21番出口から徒歩5分、月〜土 17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、不定休、カード可、電子マネー不可、34席、4人用の個室、喫煙可、2018年2月26日オープン、生ビール4種と30種以上の海外のクラフトビール (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): ベルギーやドイツのビールに詳しい店長、Yona Yona Ale、Punk IPA、Delirium、5,000〜5,500円の飲み放題コース、ジャークチキン、ビビンバ、アヒージョ、和牛ステーキ、鴨のハムのサラダ、半個室の宴会スペース。

cultural_comfort.note: Bar with banquet rooms; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own Gurunavi site; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_selected_rapport_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Mainly drinks; an egg sandwich is the only food mentioned (April 2025 review).
kyoto_selected_rapport_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Cocktails and bottles; the only food mentioned is an egg sandwich (2025 reviews).
kyoto_selected_rapport_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 20:30–03:00; closed Sundays and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Members-style: first-time visitors are asked to phone ahead and mention finding the bar through its website (Tabelog). A 2-hour, 2-drink system (Tabelog). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 80 seats with sofas and a dance floor; live music; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). In the basement of 新門荘, 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_selected_rapport_gion.notes: [Live-music bar · Higashiyama] A big basement lounge with sofas, a dance floor, and professional singers and a band playing requests until 3 am. Members-style: call ahead on a first visit. About ¥10,000–20,000.

chef_bio.background: A members-style bar asking first-timers to call ahead (Tabelog). A March 2025 guest praised the owner's smile; a September 2026 guest mentions the young master.

anecdotes.text: After a Minami-za play and dinner nearby in September 2026, a guest was introduced by the restaurant's owner, requested Brenda Lee and the Carpenters, and danced when a customer took the stage.
An April 2025 guest sang along with the live band from the sofas over a gin rickey and an egg sandwich.
A March 2025 guest found the singers' energy overwhelming and could have stayed for hours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: セレクテッドラポー、バー・ヨーロッパ料理、東山区中之町243 新門荘B1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約8分、月〜土 20:30〜翌3:00、日曜・祝日休み (変更の可能性あり)、会員制のため初めての人は電話でウェブサイトを見たと伝える、2時間2ドリンク制、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、80席、喫煙可、生演奏。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): プロの歌手とバンドの生演奏、リクエスト、ソファ席、ダンスフロア、ジントニック、ジンリッキー、卵サンド、1人1万〜2万円。

cultural_comfort.note: Call ahead on a first visit (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_sumibi_club_yuu_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori seasoned simply with salt (February 2025), but the grilled toast and some sauces are not (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_club_yuu_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken yakitori, chicken sashimi, seafood (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_club_yuu_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–02:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Bookings taken, also through Tabelog (Tabelog; July 2026 review). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, two tables of four; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). At the back of the オリエンタル会館 ground floor with no sign outside, on Tominaga-cho-dori in Gion, about 5 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_club_yuu_gion.notes: [Yakitori · Gion] A hidden, signless yakitori counter at the back of a Gion building, grilling big pieces of Kyoto red jidori over binchotan with salt, plus good sashimi and a famous charcoal toast, until 2 am. Smoking allowed. About ¥8,000–14,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 26 January 2023 (Tabelog). The master chats with counter guests (April 2025 review); grills Kyoto red jidori over binchotan (August 2025, June 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple salt seasoning to let the chicken show (February 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto red jidori yakitori; grilled toast.

anecdotes.text: A solo diner in February 2025, booking a same-day seat, struggled to find the signless door and then ate every skewer on the menu.
After a capsule-sauna session in July 2026, a guest was the first in at 7 pm, starting with chicken sashimi and ending on the grilled toast with red wine.
An August 2025 diner found the food excellent but over ¥10,000 for ten skewers and three sides — "Gion pricing".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭火倶楽部 ゆう、居酒屋・魚介料理・焼き鳥、東山区祇園町北側347-36 オリエンタル会館1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩約5分、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、14席 (カウンター6、4人テーブル2)、喫煙可、車いす可、2023年1月26日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 備長炭で焼く Kyoto Akajidori の大きな串、塩味、砂肝、ささみ、梅の胸肉、つくね、野菜の串、刺身の盛り合わせ、鶏の刺身、締めの炭火焼きトースト、Nishijin Brewery のクラフトビール、看板のない隠れ家、カウンターで大将と話す、串10本と3品で1万円超 (2025年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden counter; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_hanato_takoyakushi.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai in bonito-and-kombu dashi, sashimi with matched soy sauces, tempura, fried taro, nama-fu dengaku; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanato_takoyakushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the obanzai are cooked in dashi of bonito and kombu (Tabelog).
kyoto_hanato_takoyakushi.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30 (L.O. food 21:30, drinks 22:00); generally closed Sunday but may open in busy seasons and on holidays — check by phone or online (Tabelog). Reservations recommended — often full (April and May 2026). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 25 seats: 6 at the counter and 19 at tables (Tabelog). Heated tobacco allowed inside; ashtrays outside for cigarettes (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of アイカンパニー蛸薬師ビル, east of Karasuma on Takoyakushi, 5 min from exit 21 of Karasuma/Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_hanato_takoyakushi.notes: [Obanzai and fish · Karasuma-Takoyakushi, 2nd floor] A cosy, often full second-floor izakaya serving Kyoto obanzai in a bonito-and-kombu dashi — Manganji peppers, nama-fu dengaku, yuba — and thick-cut sashimi with soy sauces matched to each fish, with local sake and umeshu. About ¥4,000–5,000 with drinks; a ¥5,000 course. Usually closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 呉山 佳隆 (reading not sourced)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T8810440536513 is registered to an individual, 呉山 佳隆 (NTA register). Tabelog’s shop text stresses dashi of bonito and kombu and seafood bought from markets and ports.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular came back for the giant fried angel shrimp, and paid about ¥4,000 a head with sake.
A March 2026 diner noticed that sashimi and sushi came with different soy sauces matched to each fish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旨い魚と京ばんざい はなと、海鮮・寿司・居酒屋、中京区烏丸通蛸薬師東入ル一蓮社町312 アイカンパニー蛸薬師ビル 2F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅21番出口から徒歩5分、17:00〜22:30 (L.O.料理21:30、飲物22:00)、日曜は基本休み (繁忙期や祝日は営業することも)、カード・PayPay可、25席 (カウンター6、テーブル19)、加熱式たばこ可、鰹と昆布の出汁のおばんざい、市場や漁港から届く鮮魚、湯葉、生麩、賀茂なす、地酒9種と梅酒8種、7品20種のコース5,000円 (1名から)、適格請求書 T8810440536513 (呉山 佳隆)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 万願寺とうがらしの山椒煮、里芋の唐揚げ、鱧と白子の天ぷら、牛すじ煮込み、大きな海老フライ、締めのお茶漬け、生麩の二色田楽、汲み上げ湯葉、厚切りの刺身と魚ごとの醤油、茄子の天ぷら、焼き生麩、鶏団子と大根、赤こんにゃく、飲んで1人4,000〜5,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Small and often full; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_hanato_takoyakushi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26036360/ (35.006189, 135.760883); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区一蓮社町312番地 (lot) 51m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_shiko_tsukimicho.gf_detail: Ask. Creative Japanese cooking — obanzai, sashimi and courses; no gluten information (own site).
kyoto_shiko_tsukimicho.vegan_detail: Ask. Obanzai from ¥700 are listed, with no ingredients described (own site).
kyoto_shiko_tsukimicho.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and dinner 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Monday (own site). Tabelog lists dinner only, Tuesday–Sunday. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 32 seats: 8 at the counter and 8 at tables downstairs, up to 16 upstairs with tables that convert to zashiki; private hire possible (Tabelog; own site). Non-smoking (Tabelog). South of the stone steps of Yasaka Shrine on Higashioji, about 3 min from the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop (Tabelog; own site). Catering also offered (own site).
kyoto_shiko_tsukimicho.notes: [Creative Japanese · south of Yasaka Shrine, lunch and dinner] A two-floor restaurant on Higashioji just south of Yasaka Shrine, where the owner buys Kyoto produce for creative Japanese dishes — obanzai from ¥700, sashimi, courses at ¥7,700 and ¥11,000 — with good sake and shochu. Upstairs suits families and groups. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site says the owner personally buys the ingredients, led by Kyoto specialities. A June 2026 reviewer describes the owner and head chef cooking with great care.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal and standard dishes from carefully chosen Kyoto ingredients — drop in casually (own site).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor recommends it for both business gatherings and private evenings with good drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 紫洸、東山区月見町1、和食を中心とした創作料理、京都の特産物をはじめ店主自ら仕入れた食材、季節と定番の料理、1階カウンターとテーブル、2階は可変式でお座敷にも、貸し切り可、昼 12:00〜14:30 (L.O.13:30)、夜 17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、毎週月曜定休、東山安井バス停から徒歩3分、出張料理、おばんざい700円〜、刺身盛り合わせ1,500円〜、コース7,700円・11,000円、焼酎 (喜六、中々、兼八)、日本酒 (徳次郎、緑川、悦凱陣)、青谷の梅酒。食べログ: 日本料理・創作料理・居酒屋、祇園石段下下ル、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、32席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主と料理長が丁寧に作る、接待にも。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter downstairs, flexible room upstairs; cash only.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_higashiyama_yaoi_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto pickles — senmaizuke, suguki, shibazuke, kaiseki takuan, nara-zuke; seasonings are not listed and some pickles may use soy sauce or mirin (own site; reviews).
kyoto_higashiyama_yaoi_honten.vegan_detail: Ask. Pickled vegetables, but ingredients such as dashi or fish products are not listed (own site).
kyoto_higashiyama_yaoi_honten.hours_raw: Takeaway only — a Kyoto pickle shop with no meals. Monday, Wednesday–Sunday 9:00–18:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog). Seasonal pickles can be tasted and asked about in the shop; the workshop is in the alley beside it (April 2026). On Higashioji south of Yasaka Shrine, past the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing (Tabelog; 2019 review). A second shop by Kodai-ji (own site).
kyoto_higashiyama_yaoi_honten.notes: [Kyoto pickles · Higashioji, since 1934 — takeaway only] A family pickle maker founded in 1934 on this spot and now run by the third generation: senmaizuke, suguki, shibazuke and the signature chopped kaiseki takuan, plus seasonal pickles made in the workshop next door. A takeaway shop — no meals. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 村井 季亮 (reading not sourced)
chef_bio.background: The shop’s site gives its history: founded in 1934 (昭和9年) on the present site by the first generation, 村井久吉; incorporated in 1970 by the second generation, 村井明, who was named a Kyoto Prefecture master craftsman in 1996; a Kodai-ji shop opened in 1998 by the third generation, 村井季亮, also named a Kyoto Prefecture master craftsman in 2024 (readings not sourced). Pickles have won the Kyoto-Shiga pickle fair prize (1976).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor bought the new cucumber-and-myoga pickle on its first day on sale, and spotted the workshop from the alley beside the shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 有限会社 東山八百伊、京漬物製造販売 (千枚漬、すぐき、しば漬、懐石たくあん)、創業 昭和9年2月10日、設立 昭和45年5月4日、代表者 村井季亮、沿革: 昭和9年 初代 村井久吉が現所在地にて創業、昭和45年 二代目 村井明が有限会社を設立、昭和51年 京滋漬物品評会で農林流通局長賞、昭和54年 店舗新築、平成6年 新工場、平成8年 二代目が京都府優秀技能賞、平成10年 三代目 村井季亮が高台寺に新店舗、平成31年 オンラインショップ、令和6年 三代目が京都府優秀技能賞、看板商品の懐石たくあん (一年熟成のひねたくあんを刻み、生姜・青紫蘇・白ごまで)。食べログ: 東山八百伊 本店、東山区東大路松原下ル4丁目毘沙門町44、月・水〜日 9:00〜18:00、火曜定休、カード可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 減塩のあっさりした京漬物、胡瓜と茗荷の紫蘇風味、お茶漬け七菜、隣の路地の工房。

cultural_comfort.note: A shop counter; takeaway only.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing; review dated April 2026.

kyoto_surugaya_gion_shimosato.gf_detail: Ask. Ginger hiyashi-ame and ame-yu drinks, candies and bean brittle; monaka have wafer shells. Ingredients per product are not published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_surugaya_gion_shimosato.vegan_detail: Ask. Ginger-syrup drinks, candies and soybean brittle may be plant-based, but ingredients are not published; the ice cream is not vegan (official site; reviews).
kyoto_surugaya_gion_shimosato.hours_raw: Takeaway shop: 11:00–18:00, closed Wednesday; closed on some festival days, posted on Instagram (Tabelog; July 2026). Hiyashi-ame and ame-yu can be sampled or drunk in the shop with tea (2024–2026 reviews). Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). Popular sweets such as Otsutsu sell out — reserving ahead is advised (March 2024; January 2025). In a registered cultural property, the 下里家住宅, built in 1895 as an ochaya, on Sueyoshi-cho in Gion (official site).
kyoto_surugaya_gion_shimosato.notes: [Sweets · Gion Sueyoshi-cho, a 1818 candy house] A family sweets shop founded in 1818 as a branch of the great Surugaya, in an 1895 former teahouse that is a registered cultural property. Try the gently gingery hiyashi-ame (about ¥400) in the shop, then take home soybean brittle or the big Otsutsu candies beloved of maiko. Takeaway; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The official site says the shop was founded in 1818 (Bunsei 1) as a branch of 総本家駿河屋, first selling neri-yokan taught by the head house; the third generation created 祇園豆平糖, inspired by candy sold at Yasaka Shrine, and the family crest dates at least to the fourth generation, 孝太郎. A March 2024 reviewer says the business had paused and its building was for sale, until the owner’s daughter bought it back and reopened.
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple sweets need true technique; to carry Gion’s charm and Kyoto scenery into the future together with the historic building (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Hiyashi-ame; 祇園豆平糖; 大つゝ.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 visitor on the way to Kabuki at Minami-za found the sweets sold out and had a cold hiyashi-ame instead.
An August 2024 guest learned that ginger cools the body when cold and warms it when hot, over a hiyashi-ame gin soda.
A January 2025 visitor watched the monaka being filled with red bean paste on the spot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: するがや祇園下里、文政元年 (1818年) に総本家駿河屋の別家として創業、本家から伝授された煉羊羹を主に商い、3代目が八坂神社境内の「かんかん飴」から「祇園豆平糖」を考案、飴菓子を販売、4代目孝太郎の代からの紋、花街・祇園の末吉町、生姜など上質な素材、舞妓・芸妓や芸事の方々に愛される、京都市登録有形文化財「下里家住宅」(明治28年 (1895) にお茶屋として建築)、商品: ひやしあめ・あめ湯、大つゝ、祇園豆平糖、アイスクリーム、ひやしあめ濃縮350円から、歌舞伎座の顔見世で販売。食べログ: 和菓子、京都市東山区末吉町80、月火木〜日 11:00〜18:00、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 一時休業し建物が売りに出されたが店主の娘が買い戻して再開、ひやしあめ400円、ひやしあめのジンソーダやウイスキー、抹茶ひやしあめ、あめ湯、もなかはその場であんを詰める、大つゝは売り切れが多く予約がおすすめ、試飲できる、祇園祭の時期は休みも。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway; tastings offered; cards accepted.

existence.note: Official site (news to November 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026. Drafted under Greg’s 2026-11-07 retail-food ruling: founded 1818, run by the 下里 family through the generations.

kyoto_yakiniku_horumon_daigoro.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku, horumon and raw-meat dishes with sauces and salt; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_horumon_daigoro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku and horumon restaurant (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_horumon_daigoro.hours_raw: 18:00–03:00 (last order 02:00) Monday–Saturday; 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00) Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations taken; a monthly wine-pairing evening in the private room, booked by phone or Instagram (Tabelog menu). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats with a private room; designated smoking area (Tabelog). On Kiritoshi in Gion, north of Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_horumon_daigoro.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion Kiritoshi, horumon till 3 am] A small, lively Gion yakiniku house run by chef Daigoro Yamamoto, with fresh kuroge-wagyu horumon from ¥880, raw-meat dishes and thick-cut tongue — and open until 3 am for the after-drinks crowd. A monthly wine-pairing dinner too. Earlier on Sundays.

chef_bio.background: The Tabelog menu names chef Daigoro Yamamoto, who chooses the dishes for the monthly wine-pairing evening. A January 2025 reviewer describes the owner as a former professional boxer.
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh wagyu horumon; thick-cut premium tongue.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 guest came at midnight after talking meat with the owner and got so caught up in conversation that few photos were taken.
An October 2024 first-timer had the thick-cut tongue grilled to the right point by the chef.
An April 2026 diner wandered in after 2 am and was impressed by the fresh horumon sashimi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉ほるもん大五郎、焼肉・ホルモン・冷麺、京都市東山区祇園町北側254-9 切通しOKIビル1F、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:00)、日曜・祝日 18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、予約可、カード可、電子マネー不可、30席、個室あり、分煙。メニュー (2024年12月): 毎月のワインペアリング会 (料理長 (Daigoro Yamamoto) が選ぶ、6種のワイン)、黒毛和牛のホルモン880円から (小腸、赤センマイ、ハツなど)、ハツ刺し980円、ツカミのユッケ1,280円、上ミノ1,180円、塩タン1,980円、極厚上タン3,480円、ハラミ1,680円。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 深夜3時まで、肉寿司、ユッケ、スペンサーロール、ミスジの炙り、アボカドと海苔の佃煮、キムチ、コース、元プロボクサーの店主、新鮮なホルモンの刺身、祇園にしては手頃という声も高めという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; open late.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (menu updated December 2024); reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_dokoro_ryuho.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with salt or sauce, tongue yukhoe, kimchi; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_dokoro_ryuho.hours_raw: 20:00–08:00 daily except Wednesday, including holidays (Tabelog). Busiest after 2 am; quiet from 20:00 to midnight (September 2024; July 2025). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 22 seats: tatami tables for 4 and 6 and a 2-seat counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog). In the basement of the Kiyamachi BEST BILD building — the lift opens into the restaurant — on Kiyamachi south of Sanjo (Tabelog; September 2024).
kyoto_yakiniku_dokoro_ryuho.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi near Sanjo, from 8 pm to 8 am] A hidden basement yakiniku on Kiyamachi that runs all night — quiet in the evening, busy after 2 am. Generous loin, kalbi and skirt from about ¥1,100 a plate, salted tongue and tongue yukhoe, on tatami tables. Smoking allowed; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2022–2025) describe a yakiniku restaurant in the basement of a Kiyamachi building of clubs and bars, open from 8 pm until 8 am, with fun staff and good-value meat.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 visitor at 11 pm found one table taken and was told it fills after midnight.
A February 2025 horumon craving after a night out ended here with loin and bone-in kalbi.
A December 2023 guest singled out the beef-tongue yukhoe.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉処 竜宝、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、京都市中京区木屋町通三条下る大黒町71 木屋町BEST.BILD B1F、月火木〜日・祝日 20:00〜翌8:00、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR可、22席 (座敷4名×2、6名×2、カウンター2)、喫煙可。メニュー (2022年): ロース1,100円・上ロース1,700円・特選ロース2,300円、カルビ同、骨付きカルビ1,200円、塩タン1,100円、ねぎタン1,200円、特選タン2,200円、ハラミ1,500円・上ハラミ1,800円・特上ハラミ2,500円、上ミノ1,400円、ツカミ・赤テッチャン900円。口コミ (2022〜2025年、英語): 朝8時まで、2時過ぎに混む、エレベーターを降りるとすぐ店、牛タンのユッケ、生肉、キムチ、楽しいスタッフ、手頃な値段。

cultural_comfort.note: Open all night; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2025.

kyoto_marumiya_jr.gf_detail: Not GF: horumon curry, noodles to finish and soy-based simmered dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_marumiya_jr.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork and offal specialist (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_marumiya_jr.hours_raw: Daily 16:30–24:00; closing days irregular (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥200 per person before tax (Tabelog original お座席はおひとり様200円（税別）のチャージあり). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money (IC, iD, QUICPay) and PayPay (Tabelog). 28 places: 12 at tables, 6 at the counter and about 10 standing (Tabelog). Smoking allowed; e-cigarettes only at the standing counter (Tabelog). Renovated in 2025, reopening in July, with solid-wood tables (June 2025; May 2026); an August 2026 reviewer says the name has changed. Nakagawa building 1F on Kawaramachi above Sanjo; 1 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 July 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_marumiya_jr.notes: [Pork horumon bar · Kawaramachi by City Hall] The city-centre sister of Kujo's pork house マルミヤ亭: steamed pork and pig's trotters, offal sashimi, horumon grilled over charcoal and a pork-heavy menu, at tables, counter or standing. Freshly renovated; ¥200 seat charge; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a pork and horumon izakaya with standing seats opened 22 July 2022, the sister of マルミヤ亭 (kyoto_marumiya_tei) in Kujo; renovated and reopened in July 2025 (June 2025; May 2026). An August 2026 reviewer notes the restaurant's name has changed.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 Saturday drinker had the then ¥1,000 senbero set of steamed pork, kimchi and bean sprouts with a draught beer.
A February 2026 diner, a Kujo pork-house regular, found the pig's trotters spot on and praised the beef heart sashimi.
A May 2026 returnee missed the senbero set but liked the renovation and its solid-wood tables.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・立ち飲み、中京区河原町通三条上る下丸屋町401-6 中川ビル 1F、地下鉄市役所前駅から徒歩1分、毎日 16:30〜24:00、不定休、予約可、お座席は1人200円 (税別) のチャージ、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー (交通系IC・iD・QUICPay)・PayPay 可、28席 (テーブル12、カウンター6、立ち飲み約10)、喫煙可 (立ち飲みは電子たばこのみ)、2022年7月22日開店。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年8月、英語): 九条のマルミヤ亭の姉妹店、蒸し豚、豚足、豚の顔の煮物、刺身の盛り合わせ、ハツ刺し、センマイ、タンとレバーの煮込み、七輪のホルモン串、ヒレ、トロホルモン、すね、牡蠣のポテトサラダ、卵のサラダ、焼きおにぎり、ホルモンカレー、締めの麺、飲み放題のコース6,000円 (2025年4月)、1,000円のせんべろセットは終了 (2026年5月)、改装して7月に再開 (2025年6月)、店名が変わった (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥200 seat charge; standing counter; smoking allowed; cards, IC and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026; an August 2026 reviewer says the name has changed.

kyoto_matoya_kaki_shima_hanto.gf_detail: Ask. Raw oysters with lemon may suit, but the house ponzu, fried oysters, croquettes and gratin are not wheat-free; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_matoya_kaki_shima_hanto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an oyster house with Matsusaka beef croquettes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_matoya_kaki_shima_hanto.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:00; holidays 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog original なし). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: a counter in front, four tables for four at the back by a courtyard, a private room for six (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Shirotori building 1F on Sanjo east of Takakura, opposite the Museum of Kyoto; 4 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 9 December 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_matoya_kaki_shima_hanto.notes: [Oyster house · Sanjo-Takakura] A calm Sanjo oyster house serving Matoya oysters from Mie raw with a ginger ponzu, vinegared, fried or grilled, plus summer rock oysters and good-value lunches like the Matsusaka beef croquette set. Counter in front, tables by a courtyard. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: an oyster shop of Matoya in Mie Prefecture offering produce from Shima, opened 9 December 2022 (Tabelog), with a long counter and tables by a courtyard (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular on a third rock-oyster season says each oyster is so big it is cut into three, and swears by the house ginger ponzu.
A July 2026 visitor coming out of the Museum of Kyoto opposite stopped for raw Matoya oysters and a glass of wine.
A September 2026 diner hunting for a proper potato-and-beef croquette lunch found one here, with a menchi katsu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かき・オイスターバー・居酒屋、中京区三条高倉東入桝屋町55 三条高倉白鳥ビル 1F、地下鉄烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、月・水〜日 11:30〜14:30、17:00〜22:00、祝日 11:00〜14:30、17:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可、サービス料なし、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、38席、6名の個室、禁煙、2022年12月9日開店。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 三重県志摩の的矢かきと食材、生がきにレモンと自家製の生姜ポン酢、酢がき、カキフライとタルタル、焼きがき、グラタン、田楽、夏は大きな岩がきを3つに切る、昼は的矢かきの定食、松阪牛のコロッケ定食1,300円、コロッケとメンチカツの定食、かきのセット2,700円、手前にカウンター、奥に中庭の見える4人掛け4卓、京都文化博物館の向かい。

cultural_comfort.note: No service charge; lunch sets; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_tsuyushabu_chiriri_bettei.gf_detail: Not GF: dashi-and-soy dipping broth, tempura and soba to finish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsuyushabu_chiriri_bettei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork shabu-shabu, Omi beef sushi and sashimi courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsuyushabu_chiriri_bettei.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 11:30–15:00 (last drinks 14:30) and 17:00–21:30 (last orders food 20:30, drinks 21:00); Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 100% charge for same-day cancellation (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog original サービス料 10％). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 90 seats, all in private rooms for 2 to 20 (Tabelog; September 2026). A traditional building on a quiet street, 1 min walk from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 4 December 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsuyushabu_chiriri_bettei.notes: [Tsuyushabu · Shijo-Karasuma, private rooms] A calm traditional house of private rooms for Kyoto "tsuyushabu": paper-thin Iwate pork dipped in hot water, then in a gentle dashi with a mountain of white leek and yuzu kosho, in a course with sashimi, Omi beef nigiri and soba to finish. 10% service; full charge for same-day cancellations.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: the Shijo-Karasuma annex of Kyoto Tsuyushabu CHIRIRI, opened 4 December 2024, serving tsuyushabu courses in a traditional building of private rooms (2026 reviews). Our crawls show two other CHIRIRI shops, the main shop and one in Osaka.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 lunch guest had the Ibuki course with Omi beef nigiri and Iwate Hakkinton pork, finding the fatty belly surprisingly light.
An October 2026 diner noted the pork is sliced to 0.8 mm and blooms like white flowers in the hot water; the Ibuki course was ¥7,980.
A September 2026 guest brought a mother to lunch and found the leek-heavy tsuyushabu easy for older diners.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼き・日本料理、下京区仏光寺通烏丸東入上柳町325、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩1分、月〜土 11:30〜15:00 (飲み物 L.O.14:30)、17:00〜21:30 (L.O.料理20:30、飲み物21:00)、日・祝日 11:30〜15:00、17:00〜21:00、不定休、予約可、当日キャンセルは100%、サービス料10%、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、90席、個室 (2〜20名)、2024年12月4日開店、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): つゆしゃぶ (0.8mm の薄切りの豚をお湯にくぐらせ、白ねぎと柚子胡椒たっぷりの何段階も重ねただしで)、Ibuki コース7,980円 (前菜、刺身3種、岩手の Hakkinton 豚のばらのつゆしゃぶと野菜、近江牛のにぎり、名残り鱧・松茸・かぼちゃ・なすの天ぷらなど季節の一品、締めのそば、デザート)、全室個室、落ち着いた和の建物。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms; 10% service; 100% same-day cancellation; cards and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_sakaho_gara_ten_gojo.gf_detail: Not GF: tempura, croquettes, chicken katsu, Kyushu soy sauce and udon to finish (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakaho_gara_ten_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, horse sashimi and motsu-nabe (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakaho_gara_ten_gojo.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–24:00 (Tabelog). Tabelog also lists Sunday and holidays 17:30–24:00 but says Sundays are usually a day off, open for private bookings or in busy periods, so Sunday is left out here; holidays 17:30–24:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day, after 19:30 the next day and groups of 11 or more by phone (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 39 seats: 8 at the counter and sunken-kotatsu tables; a semi-private room for 6; private hire for over 30 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed on weekdays; no smoking inside on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, with a smoking area outside (Tabelog). Kyoei Daiichi building B1F, 2 min walk from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 8 April 2002 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakaho_gara_ten_gojo.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi-Gojo, basement] A friendly basement izakaya open since 2002: sashimi with sweet Kyushu soy, horse sashimi, seasonal fish and motsu-nabe at night, and cheap weekday lunch sets for local office workers. Smoking allowed on weekdays only. Sunday hours vary.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya of seasonal ingredients opened 8 April 2002 near Kiyomizu-Gojo, known for sashimi with Kyushu soy sauce and horse sashimi. A September 2026 reviewer who often holds gatherings here praises the friendly owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 solo traveller from Kanto, turned away everywhere for two hours on a weekend, finally found a seat here for squid tempura and yuba sashimi.
A September 2026 group of ten on an all-you-can-drink course got a whole sanma on the sashimi plate, and the owner treated the group to ice cream.
A December 2025 business traveller found it a quick izakaya lunch but hard going as a non-smoker.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・もつ鍋、下京区西橋詰町796 京栄第一ビル B1F、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩約2分、月〜土 11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、17:30〜24:00、日・祝日 17:30〜24:00 と記載しつつ日曜は基本休み (貸切や繁忙期は営業)、予約可 (当日・翌日19:30以降・11名以上は電話で)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・電子マネー・QR 可、39席 (カウンター8、掘りごたつ)、6名の半個室、30名以上で貸切可、喫煙可 (土日祝日は店内終日禁煙、店外に喫煙所)、2002年4月8日開店、九州の醤油の刺身と上馬刺し。口コミ (2018年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 刺身の舟盛り、馬のたてがみとハツ、いかの天ぷら、湯葉の刺身、なめこ、揚げ出し豆腐、秋のさんま、締めのうどん、昼のカニクリームコロッケ定食850円、チキンカツ、柚子胡椒のたれの鶏の日替わり、コーヒー +100円、飲み放題のコース、気さくな店主 (2026年9月)、喫煙できる店で非喫煙者にはつらい (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed on weekdays; phone for same-day bookings; cards, IC and QR.
