kyoto_le_gabriel_teramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: demi-glace and cream sauces on the omurice, beef stroganoff (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_le_gabriel_teramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg omurice with chicken or salmon, lobster soup, beef stroganoff (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_le_gabriel_teramachi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–13:30 and 17:00–22:30; closed Wednesday; may change (Tabelog). Lunch is a single weekly omurice, served as soon as you sit (April 2024; October 2025). No e-money (Tabelog). 7 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Teramachi Kyara Building 2F, just off the Teramachi arcade (Tabelog; April 2024). Opened 2 August 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_le_gabriel_teramachi.notes: [Bistro · Teramachi, since 2016] A tiny seven-seat counter upstairs just off the Teramachi arcade, playing jazz. Lunch is one weekly omurice — demi-glace, cream or yuba — for about ¥1,000, served as soon as you sit, with blancmange to follow; dinner brings bistro dishes such as lobster soup and beef stroganoff. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a counter bistro opened in August 2016 near Teramachi.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 lunch guest was served without ordering, since the weekly omurice is the only dish.
An April 2024 passer-by followed the sign in for a yuba and vegetable cream omurice, to jazz at the counter.
An October 2024 dinner guest called both the lobster soup and the beef stroganoff delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ、中京区天性寺前町541 寺町伽羅 2F、月・火・木〜日11:30〜13:30 と17:00〜22:30、水曜休み、電子マネー不可、カウンター7席、禁煙、2016年8月2日オープン。口コミ (2020年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 昼は週替わりのオムライス1種のみ (スープとサラダ付き)、湯葉と野菜のクリーム、デミグラス、鮭のクリーム、オムライス1,000円、ブランマンジェ600円、夜はオマール海老のスープ、ビーフストロガノフ、ジャズの流れる店。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch is a single dish, served without ordering (October 2025).

kyoto_shirakawa_tamura.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kaiseki with dashi-based soups, grilled fish and desserts by a pastry chef (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_shirakawa_tamura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: straw-grilled bonito, ayu sushi, dashi-based soups (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shirakawa_tamura.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday; may change (Tabelog). Reservations advised (April 2026). Cash or QR only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: a 9-seat counter, a private room for 4–6 and an upstairs tatami room for 10–16 (Tabelog; January 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On a lane north off Shinmonzen-dori just east of Hanamikoji (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 1 June 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_shirakawa_tamura.notes: [Kaiseki · Shinmonzen, since 2014] A kaiseki restaurant on a lane off Shinmonzen near Hanamikoji, with a counter facing the chef, a private room and an upstairs tatami room. Courses follow the season with playful touches — Halloween plates, ehomaki at Setsubun — bonito seared over burning straw at the counter, and desserts from an in-house pastry chef. Cash or QR only; closed Sunday.

roles: Head chef/owner (unnamed), praised for warmth (September 2025; August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant opened in June 2014 near Shinmonzen in Gion; reviewers note an in-house pastry chef.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular’s party of eight had ehomaki ahead of Setsubun in the upstairs tatami room.
An August 2026 diner had the summer ayu sushi, its bones fried into crisp crackers.
An October 2026 guest watched bonito seared over straw at the counter during the Halloween menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園新門前通花見小路東入一筋目上ル、月〜土12:00〜14:30 と18:00〜22:00、日曜休み、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、31席 (カウンター9、個室4〜6、座敷10〜16)、禁煙、2014年6月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 季節の会席、パティシエのデザート、恵方巻き、クリームブリュレ、短いコース、鮎の寿司と骨せんべい、ハロウィンの献立 (モンブラン風、冷たいかぼちゃのスープ、燻製の大根と梨の最中)、目の前で藁焼きのかつお、親切な料理長。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring cash or a QR payment app; sit at the counter to watch the chef. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kazeno_ne_sakaimachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded pork cutlets in katsudon and katsu sandwiches (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kazeno_ne_sakaimachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlet bowls and sandwiches with red miso soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kazeno_ne_sakaimachi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); irregular closures; closes when sold out (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog); a November 2025 visitor found it cash-only at opening. Dine-in or takeaway (December 2025; January 2026). 15 seats: a 6-seat counter and four small tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the small hotel kyoto soyo_ka, Sakaimachi-dori south of Sanjo, across from the Inoda Coffee main shop (Tabelog; November 2025). Opened November 2025 (reviews).
kyoto_kazeno_ne_sakaimachi.notes: [Thick-cut katsudon · Sakaimachi-Sanjo, since 2025] A small counter restaurant in the lobby floor of a boutique hotel opposite Inoda Coffee, which opened with Tokyo’s HITOKAMI tenderloin katsu sandwiches and now centres on 300 g thick-cut Kyoto Mochi Pork katsudon (¥2,200–3,000) with red miso soup. Takeaway sandwiches; reviews are mixed. Open daily to 21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: opened in November 2025 in a hotel near Inoda Coffee’s main shop as a collaboration with HITOKAMI, an Aoyama (Tokyo) tenderloin katsu sandwich shop famous at bread festivals; by mid-2026 it had refocused on thick-cut katsudon.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor found the opening pushed back from the 8th to the 14th, and payment cash-only at first.
A May 2026 diner’s 300 g spencer roll katsu was too big to fit in the bowl.
An October 2026 diner was surprised how easy the 300 g loin katsudon was to finish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂・とんかつ・カツ丼、中京区堺町通三条下る道祐町135 kyoto soyo_ka 1F、地下鉄烏丸御池駅から徒歩10分、毎日11:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、不定休、売り切れ次第終了、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、15席 (カウンター6、テーブル)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): イノダコーヒ本店の斜め向かいのホテルの1階、東京・青山の HITOKAMI とのコラボのヒレカツサンド1,800円 (ソース10種、4個入りの箱)、のちに厚切りのカツ丼の専門店に、京都もち豚のスペンサーロール300g 3,000円と赤だし、カレー追加200円、上ロース300g 2,200円、評価は賛否。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; takeaway available. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sakedokoro_kagome.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, mackerel sushi, oden and snacks for sake, chosen to taste with the staff (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_sakedokoro_kagome.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, mackerel sushi and oden (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sakedokoro_kagome.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00 (last food order 22:30); closed Sunday and holidays; a 12:00–14:00 lunch was suspended (Tabelog). Reservations advised, especially on nights the owner works alone; bookings for more than two may not be possible (April 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: a 7-seat counter and a semi-private table for four (Tabelog). Smoking in a designated area (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori, 8 min from Gojo or Shijo-Karasuma (Tabelog; April 2026). Opened 10 January 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakedokoro_kagome.notes: [Sake izakaya · Matsubara, since 2020] A small, chatty counter izakaya on Matsubara-dori where the owner picks the sake, including Furuosen from Shiga, and the blackboard runs to sashimi, mackerel sushi, oden and Western- and Chinese-leaning snacks, suggested to your taste. Mostly regulars; book ahead, especially for more than two. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a sake-focused counter izakaya opened in January 2020, which calls itself a "talkative izakaya" (February 2025).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 walk-in, whose first choice was full, was drawn into conversation at once — the owner calls it a talkative izakaya.
An April 2026 regular advises booking for nights when the owner works alone.
A November 2025 first-timer expected an oden shop and found the other dishes just as good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、下京区杉屋町269-3、地下鉄五条駅・四条烏丸から徒歩8分、月〜土17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:30)、日曜・祝日休み、昼の営業は休止、現金のみ、11席 (カウンター7、テーブル4)、分煙、2020年1月10日オープン。口コミ (2022年7月〜2026年4月、英語): 店主が選ぶ日本酒、滋賀の Furuosen の酒、本格的な鯖寿司、刺身、おでん、和洋中のつまみ、黒板のメニュー、好みに合わせて提案、話好きの居酒屋、店主ひとりの日は予約を。

cultural_comfort.note: Some staff speak English (February 2025); say what flavours you like. Cash only.

kyoto_rokkaku_chikiriya_chaho.gf_detail: Ask: the teas themselves (matcha, hojicha) are the focus; the sweets include parfaits with cornflakes and cookies, yatsuhashi on the soft serve, and tea soba (2022–2026 reviews), so most desserts contain wheat.
kyoto_rokkaku_chikiriya_chaho.vegan_detail: Ask: matcha and hojicha by the cup are plant-based; the parfaits and soft serve contain ice cream and cream (2022–2026 reviews). Zenzai and warabi mochi were not described.
kyoto_rokkaku_chikiriya_chaho.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 10:00–17:00 (food L.O. 16:30); closed Sunday, Obon and New Year; open on some public holidays in peak seasons — check Instagram Stories. Reservations taken. Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR. 14 seats in the 2nd-floor café; tea sold and take-out drinks at the 1st-floor counter. Non-smoking. Children welcome. Rokkaku-dori just east of Higashinotoin, 3 min walk from Karasuma-Oike exit 5. Run by 有限会社六角ちきりや茶舗 (NTA invoice register).
kyoto_rokkaku_chikiriya_chaho.notes: [Tea shop café · Rokkaku-dori near Karasuma-Oike, an old tea merchant's upstairs room] A tea merchant of over 110 years with a calm café upstairs: matcha with a sweet for ¥1,000, generous hojicha and matcha parfaits about ¥900, and tea soft serve to go from the shop counter. Usually uncrowded. Closed Sunday.

roles: Tea merchant (有限会社六角ちきりや茶舗)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's remarks call it a small tea shop in business for over 110 years; the café opened on 13 July 2010 and was renovated in October 2019. A January 2026 reviewer writes that Chikiriya dates from the first year of Ansei. Reviewers describe warm staff, a quiet café that rarely has a queue, and the shop on the 1st floor. Criticism: the warabi mochi was average (March 2026); parfait ice cream melts quickly (September 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha and hojicha parfaits; matcha set.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "I braced myself for a crowd, considering it was a holiday afternoon around 3 PM in Kyoto, but to my surprise, there were no customers at all."
September 2024: "It truly has the deep flavor of matcha; it felt like I was enjoying matcha itself in ice cream form."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 六角ちきりや茶舗、カフェ、中京区六角通東洞院東入三文字町226-2、地下鉄烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩3分、月〜土10:00〜17:00 (料理L.O.16:30)、日曜休み、お盆・年末年始休み、繁忙期は祝日も営業 (Instagramのストーリーで告知)、予約可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、14席、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト、創業110年以上の小さなお茶屋、喫茶は2010年7月13日開始、2019年10月に改装。インボイス登録は有限会社六角ちきりや茶舗。口コミ (2022年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 1階は茶の販売、2階が喫茶、ほうじ茶パフェ900円、抹茶パフェ、抹茶セット (お菓子付き) 1,000円、八ッ橋入りのソフトクリームミックス400円、抹茶とぜんざい、濃い抹茶アイス、わらび餅、茶そば・お雑煮・あんみつ、安政元年創業との記載 (2026年1月)、混んでいない、わらび餅は普通との声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Quiet tea-shop café; cards and QR accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated January, March and July 2026.

kyoto_hanakagami_rokuhara.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: obanzai set meals with dashi-based dishes, beef stew, tempura, tempura zaru soba and nishin soba (2023–2026 reviews). The shop says it handles allergies as far as it can, but some dishes, such as those using dashi, cannot be changed: 「アレルギー等にも可能な限り対応致します（一部出汁など対応不可のお料理がございます）」 (hanakagami.co.jp).
kyoto_hanakagami_rokuhara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled fish, rolled omelet, beef stew and dashi in the obanzai set; a yudofu set exists, but its broth was not described (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanakagami_rokuhara.hours_raw: Official site (hanakagami.co.jp): lunch 11:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00 from October 2026), dinner 17:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:00); closed Wednesday, with extra closures and private bookings posted on the site; same-day and next-day bookings by phone only. Tabelog lists daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:30 — the site is newer. Kaiseki (from ¥7,000) and suppon hot pot by reservation only. Cards. Four tables, 16 seats. On Matsubara-dori near Rokuharamitsu-ji; 12 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo. Moved here from Kiyomizu in summer 2021.
kyoto_hanakagami_rokuhara.notes: [Obanzai & Kyoto cuisine · Rokuhara near Rokuharamitsu-ji, a four-table dining room] A tiny traditional room on Matsubara-dori serving colourful obanzai lunch sets (about ¥1,500, with a dab of beef stew), bento and soba, plus kaiseki and suppon hot pot by reservation. Book ahead — only 16 seats. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The site says the cooking is by a craftsman who learned Japanese cuisine from the basics, and that the restaurant moved from Kiyomizu to Rokuhara in summer 2021, keeping its popular dishes in a four-table room. Reviewers describe kind service, an owner and hostess, autumn leaves on the plates (October 2025) and many overseas guests. Criticism: a May 2025 reviewer lost a 1 pm booking after arriving about 15 minutes late on the restaurant's own advice, and was told it was the diner's fault before the hostess later apologized.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「常にお客様においしいものを食べていただきたいという心を持って料理をつくる」 — always cook with the wish that guests eat something delicious (hanakagami.co.jp).
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai set; beef stew; kaiseki by reservation.

anecdotes.text: November 2024: "The meal included grilled fish, Japanese omelette, shrimp beans, yuzu miso sauce with shrimp tuber, sesame tofu, beef stew, simmered komatsuna (Japanese mustard spinach), simmered hijiki, rice, clear soup, and pickles."
October 2025: "What particularly impressed me was the use of real autumn leaves on the plates."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hanakagami.co.jp): 京料理 花かがみ、東山区轆轤町103-1、松原通沿い、六波羅蜜寺のすぐ近く、清水五条から徒歩12分、昼11:00〜14:30 (2026年10月よりL.O.14:00)・夜17:00〜20:00 (L.O.19:00)、水曜定休、臨時休業・貸切あり、前日・当日の予約は電話のみ、令和3年夏に清水から移転、テーブル4つで16名、会席 (7,000円〜) とすっぽん鍋は予約のみ、すっぽん鍋定食 昼4,000円・夜4,500円、天ざるそば1,800円、「アレルギー等にも可能な限り対応致します（一部出汁など対応不可のお料理がございます）」、お節の注文受付。食べログ: 和食、カード可。口コミ (2023年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 京のおばんざい定食1,400〜1,500円 (焼き魚、だし巻き、ごま豆腐、ビーフシチュー、小松菜、ひじき)、ビーフシチュー定食1,700円、花かがみ弁当 (刺身と生湯葉、天ぷら、佃煮、焼き魚)、湯豆腐定食、天ぷら定食、にしんそば、もみじを添えた盛り付け (2025年10月)、予約の行き違いへの不満 (2025年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Only 16 seats — book by phone; the shop will try to adapt dishes for allergies, except some dashi-based ones (official site).

staff_allergy_handling: Official site: will accommodate allergies as far as possible, but some dishes, such as those using dashi, cannot be changed.

existence.note: Official site updated 6 November 2026; Tabelog reviews dated July and September 2026.

kyoto_hanakagami_rokuhara.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26036832/ (34.997752, 135.774471); GSI lot 京都府京都市東山区轆轤町103番地 about 14m away; nearest pin kyoto_korisu 21m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_koeto_soeto_senbei.gf_detail: Ask: rice-cracker (senbei) dishes and rice-flour pancakes (2026 reviews), but the crackers come in flavors such as white miso, green-onion miso, curry and wasabi mayo, and the dashi chazuke and mitarashi sauce were not described — soy and wheat are likely in several.
kyoto_koeto_soeto_senbei.vegan_detail: Ask: a matcha soy-milk pudding is on the menu, and many crackers are plant-based flavors; the pancakes come with vanilla ice cream, the crackers include garlic shrimp, and the chazuke dashi was not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_koeto_soeto_senbei.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 9:30–17:30; closed on irregular days — check Google Maps or Instagram. No reservations. Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay). 20 table seats; private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. English menu and English-speaking staff; photo menu. Children welcome, with kids' drinks and ice cream and three children's chairs. Take-out; 16 kinds of senbei for sale. 2 min from Sanjo Keihan subway exit 2, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo exit 5. Opened 19 October 2025.
kyoto_koeto_soeto_senbei.notes: [Senbei café · Sanjo by the Kamo River, a rice-cracker tearoom] A bright new café built around rice crackers: rice-flour matcha pancakes crunchy with sesame senbei, senbei dashi chazuke for ¥800, senbei onigiri and matcha lattes, with 16 flavors of senbei to take home. English spoken. Open daily from 9:30.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 October 2025 (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer writes that the pancakes are made by a long-established rice-cracker maker, "Kyoshikaroku" (romaji as given); the NTA invoice register lists the operator as 池本車体工業株式会社. Reviewers describe a calm, modern room, kind staff who offer samples, many overseas visitors and school groups after a TV feature (July 2026). Criticism: one reviewer found the milk ice cream ordinary (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Senbei dishes; Uji matcha rice-flour pancakes.

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "This dish features fragrant negi miso rice crackers served with hot dashi poured over rice. The rice crackers gradually absorb the dashi, transforming in texture and flavor."
April 2026: "I was considering buying some rice crackers, and while I was pondering, I was offered a sample."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: KOETO SOETO、カフェ・せんべい、東山区二町目60、地下鉄三条京阪駅2番出口から徒歩2分・京阪三条駅5番出口から徒歩3分、毎日9:30〜17:30、不定休 (Googleマップ・Instagramで告知)、予約不可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、20席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、英語メニュー・英語対応スタッフ、写真付きメニュー、子供可 (子供用ドリンク・アイス、子供椅子3脚)、テイクアウト、2025年10月19日オープン、せんべいおにぎりやせんべい出汁茶漬けなど、せんべいを楽しむカフェ。インボイス登録は池本車体工業株式会社 (国税庁)。口コミ (2026年4月〜7月、英語): せんべいと出汁茶漬け800円、米粉の宇治抹茶パンケーキ1,200円 (バニラアイス、抹茶クリーム、黒ごませんべい、週末限定との記載)、宇治抹茶ラテ (ドリンクにせんべい2枚)、ほうじ茶ラテ、宇治抹茶豆乳プリン、みたらしミルクアイス、16種のせんべい (塩レモン、七味、梅ざらめ、ガーリックシュリンプ、カレーなど)、試食あり、海外の客や修学旅行生が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); samples offered.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 19 October 2025) with reviews dated April to July 2026.

kyoto_shodai_unagi_sumito.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the eel sauce is made with tamari (December 2025; July 2026 reviews) but no reviewer or listing says it is wheat-free, and the sides include fu in the liver soup (July 2026). Ask.
kyoto_shodai_unagi_sumito.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shodai_unagi_sumito.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat, holidays and the days before and after them 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–20:00; Sunday 11:00–14:00 only; closed Monday; occasional closures for events. Reservations taken; dinner by phone; unagi-maki must be ordered ahead (not same day); unaju takes about 30 min; arriving more than 10 min late cancels the booking; no-show fee; groups of 4+ cannot choose seats; no outside food or drink. No seat or otoshi charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「席料・お通し料金なし」. 15 seats: 7 at the counter, two tables for 4. Non-smoking. Cards, IC, PayPay. Children welcome. B1F of a building on the south side of Sanjo east of Sanjo Keihan (December 2025 review); 1 min from Sanjo Keihan subway. Opened 14 August 2024.
kyoto_shodai_unagi_sumito.notes: [Unagi · Sanjo east of the Kamo, a basement charcoal counter] A small, serious eel counter where eels are steamed and charcoal-grilled to order in the Kanto (Edo) style, glossed with a rich tamari sauce, or grilled straight for hitsumabushi. About ¥5,000–8,000; book ahead and allow 30 minutes. Closed Monday; Sunday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 August 2024 (Tabelog). An August 2024 reviewer writes that the owner trained for years in Shizuoka; a July 2026 reviewer describes a young, humble chef, and an August 2026 reviewer mentions pleasant service from the wife. Eels from Aichi on one 2024 visit. Criticism: the sauce is strong for those who prefer light soy (December 2024); the pickles were a little salty (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: August 2024: "After years of training in Shizuoka, the owner has finally launched this establishment… They follow the Edo-style process that includes steaming, resulting in an incredibly beautiful unaju!"
August 2026: "The eel was prepared in advance and grilled after the order was placed, so I enjoyed sipping my drink while watching the chef grill it over charcoal."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 初代 鰻すみと、うなぎ、東山区三条大橋東2-51 B1F、地下鉄三条京阪駅から東へ徒歩約1分、火〜土・祝日・祝日の前日と翌日11:00〜14:00・17:00〜20:00、日曜11:00〜14:00、月曜休み、催事で休むことあり、予約可 (夜は電話で相談)、う巻きは要予約で当日不可、肝焼きは数量限定、うな重は約30分、10分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱い、原文で「席料・お通し料金なし」、15席 (カウンター7・4名テーブル2)、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・PayPay可、子供可、公式サイト unagi-sumito.com、2024年8月14日オープン。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年9月、英語・日本語): 関東風の蒸し焼きのうな重 (特上1.5尾、上1尾)、直焼きのひつまぶし、たまりのタレ、肝焼き、白焼き、う巻き、かぼちゃ・蓮・鮎の佃煮の前菜、肝吸い、静岡で修業した店主 (2024年8月)、若く謙虚な料理人 (2026年7月)、奥さんの接客 (2026年8月)、内装はモダンでレゲエが流れる (2025年12月)、タレが濃いとの声 (2024年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; unaju takes about 30 min; lateness of 10+ min cancels the booking.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated July, August and September 2026.

kyoto_teppan_izakaya_dai.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan-grilled pork and chicken, teppan dashimaki, okonomiyaki, chicken sashimi; no gluten information (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_teppan_izakaya_dai.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kagoshima pork and chicken, chicken and horse sashimi, liver (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_teppan_izakaya_dai.hours_raw: Thursday–Sunday 17:00–00:30; closed Monday–Wednesday (Tabelog). No cards or e-money (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; private hire possible (Tabelog). Non-smoking, negotiable when booking (Tabelog). On the ground floor of 本田ビル, a short walk east of exit 8 of Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_izakaya_dai.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Sanjo-Keihan, Kagoshima pork and chicken] A ten-seat counter in a back street east of Sanjo Keihan, grilling Kagoshima pork and chicken on a thick iron plate, with teppan dashimaki, chicken sashimi and Kyushu shochu. Open Thursday to Sunday till 00:30.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes pork and chicken delivered directly from Kagoshima and a 12 mm iron plate. A June 2026 reviewer found the staff cheerful and friendly.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner had a platter of chicken sashimi, grilled liver and horse sashimi, and noticed a few Okinawan dishes on the menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄板居酒屋 だい、居酒屋、左京区法林寺門前町36-3 本田ビル 1F、京阪三条駅8番出口から東へ、木〜日 17:00〜翌0:30、月〜水定休、カード・電子マネー不可、カウンター10席、貸切可、禁煙、鹿児島直送の豚 (Chami Buta) と鶏 (Sakurajima Dori) を12mmの鉄板で、鉄板のだし巻き、鹿児島の鶏刺し、九州と沖縄の焼酎、黒板の日替わり。口コミ (2026年6月、英語): 鶏刺し、レバー焼き、馬刺し、お好み焼きと鉄板焼き、沖縄料理も少し、明るく親切なスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Ten-seat counter; no cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; latest review June 2026.

kyoto_sekka_cafe_showroom.gf_detail: Ask. French toast of Kyoto Danish bread, afternoon tea and brunch sets with deli items, soup and ice cream; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sekka_cafe_showroom.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan dishes are named; the French toast comes with butter and ice cream (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sekka_cafe_showroom.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday–Sunday and holidays 10:30–18:00 (L.O. food 17:00, drinks 17:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday unless a holiday (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし; its English wrongly says a fee may be added). Reservations accepted (September 2026). Cards, IC, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 14 seats, incl. a spacious private area (Tabelog; October 2026). On the ground floor of a machiya-style building on Aneyakoji, 3 min from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened summer 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sekka_cafe_showroom.notes: [Café · Aneyakoji, a marble showroom café] A calm café inside the marble showroom of a stone company of nearly a century, on Aneyakoji: thick French toast of Kyoto Danish bread baked on a lava-stone plate (¥1,050), afternoon tea and brunch sets on stone plates, among marble tables and art that are also for sale. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the café is brought by a stone-processing company with nearly 100 years of experience; an August 2026 reviewer says the company has worked on important cultural properties and is about 95 years old. An October 2026 group was greeted by the owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Plates of natural stone said to bring out the taste of the food (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor bought a marble coaster after the staff explained the stone products.
During Silver Week in September 2026, with every café nearby full, the staff found a seat for a reservation.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: sekka Cafe + ショールーム、カフェ・スイーツ・ジェラート、中京区木之下町299、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、月・火・金〜日・祝日 10:30〜18:00 (L.O.料理17:00、飲物17:30)、水・木定休 (祝日は営業)、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、14席、2026年夏、創業約100年の石材加工会社による「大理石のコンセプトカフェ」、溶岩石の熱で焼くふわふわのフレンチトースト、石の皿のアフタヌーンティー。口コミ (2026年、英語): 姉小路の町家風のビル1階、大理石の家具と絵画のショールーム、京都のデニッシュ食パンを溶岩プレートで焼くフレンチトースト1,050円、バニラアイスやチョコのトッピング、アフタヌーンティーとブランチセット、自家製ドリンク、デリ、スープ、大理石のコースター、店主のもてなし。

cultural_comfort.note: Calm café and showroom; staff explain the stone; no service charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_ikken_uruuru.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu and yuba dishes, smoked eel, sashimi, dashimaki, twice-fried kara-age; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ikken_uruuru.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu and yuba dishes are a speciality (Tabelog), but nothing is said about dashi; most dishes include fish or meat (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ikken_uruuru.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed on irregular days (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (July 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 38 seats over two floors, with a private room for 10–20 (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a renovated old townhouse down narrow alleys between Shijo and Gojo, near Higashinotoin-Matsubara, about 10 min from Karasuma/Shijo (Tabelog; November 2025).
kyoto_ikken_uruuru.notes: [Sake izakaya · Shijo–Gojo backstreets, an old townhouse] A two-floor sake izakaya in a renovated townhouse down narrow alleys, where knowledgeable staff pour from a long list — often off-menu — into ochoko you pick, with yuba and tofu dishes, smoked eel and crisp kara-age. All-you-can-drink sake courses for groups. Upstairs can get hot in summer.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe kind, sake-savvy staff, including someone who visits breweries (March and July 2026); a local regular has come for over a decade (March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake pairings; yuba and tofu dishes.

anecdotes.text: A group has held its annual drinking party here for more years than anyone remembers (August 2026).
The menus are made from record album covers, and even the creaky toilet door adds to the old-house charm (November 2025).
An August 2026 company party found the upstairs room scorching in summer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 一献 うるうる、居酒屋・豆腐料理・日本酒バー、下京区燈籠町東洞院松原東入ル、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩10分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:00、飲物22:30)、不定休、カード・電子マネー・QR可、38席、10〜20名の個室、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 日本酒好きの店、メニューにない酒も、選べるお猪口、日本酒の飲み放題コース、おばんざいのお通し、燻製の鰻、刺身、牛すじの卵焼き、大きな唐揚げ、湯葉料理、梅肉の沢庵、二度揚げの唐揚げ、お猪口プリン、レコードジャケットのメニュー、町家を改装、2階は夏は暑い。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff recommend sake to your taste.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_gion_ramen_sohonten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ramen_sohonten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef, back-fat and shrimp broths (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ramen_sohonten.hours_raw: Hours not listed (Tabelog). Reviewers found it open from 11:00 (February 2024) and until about 2 am (October 2024). Tickets from a vending machine (May 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). On the approach to Yasaka Shrine in Gion, many overseas visitors; a 40-minute wait for a bowl in February 2026 (reviews).
kyoto_gion_ramen_sohonten.notes: [Ramen · Yasaka Shrine] A tourist-heavy ramen shop on the approach to Yasaka Shrine, with flavours said to be supervised by a ramen veteran: beef shio, back-fat shoyu and a shrimp soba that reviewers rate best. About ¥1,200 a bowl; cash only.

chef_bio.background: A May 2025 reviewer writes that the flavours were supervised by Mr. Takemuro, founder of Mutsumi-ya; a May 2024 reviewer calls it premium ramen supervised by a legend of the ramen world. Tabelog also lists a 京都本店.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner found the shrimp soba a real bowl rather than a tourist one, with deep shrimp richness in every sip.
A February 2026 diner waited 40 minutes among tour groups for a ¥1,200 back-fat shoyu, with no apology.
A May 2025 diner found the beef shio ramen ordinary for over ¥1,000, which explained the quiet room at 1 pm.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園らーめん 京都総本店、ラーメン、東山区祇園町北側280、祇園四条駅から391m、営業時間の記載なし、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 11時開店 (2024年2月)、深夜2時ごろまで (2024年10月)、食券制 (2025年5月)、Beef Sio Ramen 1,180円 (ローストビーフ、ねぎ、白ねぎ)、Kyoto Backfat Shoyu Ramen 1,200円、Shrimp Soba 1,200円、冷やしらーめん、Mutsumi-ya の創業者 Takemuro 氏の監修 (2025年5月)、八坂神社の前で海外の客が多い、40分待ち (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; many overseas guests (2025–26 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026. No ramen block: bowl details are too thin.

kyoto_itamae_kappo_chihana.gf_detail: Ask. A kappo course with tempura, yuba, broths and vinegared dishes (June 2025 review).
kyoto_itamae_kappo_chihana.vegan_detail: Not vegan: eel, pork jowl, shrimp, fish and dashi (June 2025 review).
kyoto_itamae_kappo_chihana.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun, holidays and the days around them 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:00) and 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00); closed Tuesdays (Tabelog). Bookings by phone or online (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: an 8-seat counter and a private room for up to 6; non-smoking (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Shijo east of Hanamikoji, 5–7 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; June 2025 review).
kyoto_itamae_kappo_chihana.notes: [Kappo · Gion] A historic Gion counter kappo, founded in 1946 and moved in 2022 to a white-wood counter down an alley off Shijo: long seasonal courses served on fine old tableware. About ¥15,000–30,000.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1946 by the late Yoshio Nagata; moved to this site in October 2022 (June 2025 review). The restaurant says it has been rooted in Gion for over 70 years and moved from Shinmonzen-dori in the autumn (Tabelog). Reviewers note three Michelin stars for nine consecutive years from the 2010 Kyoto–Osaka guide (June and August 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: True to the founder's spirit, with carefully chosen ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo course; tableware by Rosanjin.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner on a tour of top-ranked restaurants listed fourteen dishes, from anago with passion fruit to salted-milk ice cream.
An August 2025 regular singled out sashimi on Rosanjin plates and mountain vegetables on Kutani ware.
A May 2026 diner found playful twists behind a classic look, though the alley entrance was hard to find.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 板前割烹 千花、日本料理、東山区祇園町北側279-8、祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、月・水〜日・祝日・祝日の前日・祝日の翌日 12:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:00)・18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 20:00)、火曜休み、予約は電話かウェブ、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、14席 (カウンター8、6名までの個室)、禁煙、祇園に70年以上、秋に Shinmonzen Street から移転 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1946年に故 Yoshio Nagata が創業、2022年10月に移転、ミシュラン三つ星9年連続 (2010年版から)、穴子とオクラとキウイ、湯葉の椀、海老の天ぷら、まながつおとしまあじのお造り、Kamo なす、Rosanjin や Kutani ware の器、15,000〜30,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter kappo; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_gion_ryori_toriimoto.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto ryotei courses with miso-marinated fish, sushi and broths (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ryori_toriimoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sea bream sushi, sawara, hamo, shirako, sea urchin (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ryori_toriimoto.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 17:30–20:00; closed Mondays and the evenings of the second and last Sunday of the month (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). Private rooms, some with sunken kotatsu and a garden view; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). In south Gion, 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_ryori_toriimoto.notes: [Ryotei · Gion] A quiet old Gion house with a garden — and a resident cat — where the okami and the okami's daughter serve classic Kyoto courses in private rooms. Lunch about ¥8,000–14,000; dinner ¥20,000–30,000.

chef_bio.background: Service by the okami and the okami's daughter (October 2025 review) or, as a January 2026 regular puts it, by the head and assistant managers rather than ordinary staff. A July 2024 diner places it on former Kenninji temple grounds. A garden cat greets guests (2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto courses in private rooms.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 guest drank beer in a warm sunken-kotatsu room, watching a cat in the garden and snowmelt dripping in the sun.
An August 2025 guest sent by an acquaintance chatted with the owner over the house-label beer.
A July 2026 guest braved the heat for nine dishes ending in two kinds of melon ice cream.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園料理 鳥居本、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-8、火〜日 12:00〜14:00・17:30〜20:00、月曜と第2・最終日曜の夜は休み、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー不可、個室、喫煙可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 女将と娘さんのもてなし (2025年10月)、Kenninji の旧境内 (2024年7月)、庭の猫、作りたての湯葉と佃煮、人参の団子と雲丹、白子、長芋の豆腐、冷やし茶碗蒸し、Ako の鯛の寿司、鰆の味噌漬け、Hamo Yanagawa Nabe、2種のメロンのアイス (2026年7月)、鳥居本のラベルのビール、オリジナルの冷酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Traditional ryotei; may be easier with an introduction (October 2025 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_cendrillon_bis.gf_detail: Ask. Pizza, gratin and fried dishes are wheat; carpaccio and steak may suit (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cendrillon_bis.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish carpaccio, beef tendon, prosciutto, steak (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cendrillon_bis.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 17:30–22:00; Sat 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:30; closed Mondays; days off posted on Instagram (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料なし」). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 24 seats: 6 at the counter, 18 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Yanagibamba south of Sanjo, 10 min from Karasuma Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_cendrillon_bis.notes: [Bistro · Sanjo-Yanagibamba] A small blue-lit bistro run by a couple, mixing French and Italian plates — a cheap drink-and-three-snacks set, pizza, a miso beef-tendon stew — with weekend lunches. Many overseas guests. About ¥2,000–4,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 11 September 2022 (Tabelog). Run by a couple (March and December 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Quick-drink set; beef-tendon miso curry stew.

anecdotes.text: A swimmer who drops in monthly after the nearby pool (July and September 2026) always takes the quick-drink set and tries one new dish.
A December 2025 guest staying nearby found prices a little high and portions small, but the beef-tendon miso curry stew original.
An April 2026 lunch diner had the ¥1,590 holiday lunch of steak and two fried dishes, though it was slow to arrive.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Cendrillon bis.、ビストロ・フレンチ・イタリアン、中京区三条柳馬場下る槌屋町84-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩10分、火〜金 17:30〜22:00、土 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜22:00、日 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜21:30、月曜休み、休みは Instagram で、チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、24席 (カウンター6、テーブル18)、禁煙、2022年9月11日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、飲み物と小皿3品の Quick Drink のセット、かぼちゃのグラタン、鮮魚のカルパッチョ920円、牛すじの味噌カレー煮込み700円、Kimagure pizza 1,480円、生ハムとドライフルーツ800円、休日ランチ1,590円 (ステーキと揚げ物2種)、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (December 2025 and April 2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_manoir28_wine_salon.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar; snacks come from well-known Kyoto restaurants and no ingredients are published (official site).
kyoto_manoir28_wine_salon.vegan_detail: Ask. Wine by the glass and bottle; snacks and kaiseki come from other restaurants (official site).
kyoto_manoir28_wine_salon.hours_raw: Invitation-only (Tabelog): first-time guests register as manoir28 LINE members and book by message; anyone who wants to enjoy wine may come once registered (official site). 15:00–24:00, irregular closing days (official site; Tabelog). Seat charge: none 15:00–18:00, ¥2,000 a person from 18:00; 10% service (official site). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter and private rooms for 6 to 20; non-smoking, smoking in the courtyard (Tabelog; official site). A house facing a small park — taxis can drop at Fuyacho-Rokkaku (official site).
kyoto_manoir28_wine_salon.notes: [Wine bar · Fuyacho-Rokkaku, invitation-only wine salon] A house by a small park given over to wine: about 20 Burgundies and Champagnes by the glass (¥3,000–10,000) from a deep cellar, from 3 pm. It is invitation-only — first-timers register via its LINE account and book by message. No seat charge before 6 pm.

roles: Owner and sommelier staff not named
chef_bio.background: Opened in February 2019 (Tabelog). A July 2022 reviewer says it belongs to Kitamura, known as the "wine prince" of Nagoya, with a walk-in cellar of about 1,500 bottles including DRC; the official site describes a wine salon in a house facing a park on Fuyacho.
chef_bio.philosophy: To make time spent with wine the finest moment of a guest’s life (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Fine Burgundy and Champagne by the glass.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular dropped in early for an aperitif before dinner, just in time for the cherry blossom.
A June 2024 visitor explained the way in: register on LINE, then reserve.
A September 2026 guest returned with a friend from Tokyo for a bottle of white and staff-chosen glasses.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: manoir28 (マノワール28)、ワインテイスティングサロン、京都市中京区八百屋町98-3、麩屋町の公園の前の一軒家、ブルゴーニュとシャンパーニュを中心にグラス1杯から、グラスワイン20種ほど (3,000〜10,000円)、ボトル300アイテム以上 (20,000円から)、15:00〜24:00、不定休、カード可、喫煙は中庭、タクシーは麩屋町六角で下車、シートチャージ 15:00〜18:00は無料・18:00からは1人2,000円、サービス料10%、ミシュラン店の京懐石を個室で (3日前までに予約)、京都の銘店のおつまみと軽食、はじめての客は LINE メンバー登録のうえメッセージで予約 (ワインを愉しみたい方はどなたでも)。食べログ: ワインバー、紹介制のワインバー、2019年2月28日オープン、個室 (6〜20名)、禁煙。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 名古屋の「ワインの王子」北村氏の店、1,500本のセラー、DRC、15時から開いて食前にも二次会にも、グラスで上質なワインを、気さくなマスター、地元の名店の料理を事前に頼める。

cultural_comfort.note: Invitation-only: register via LINE and book ahead; seat charge from 18:00.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026. Invitation-only, listed with the restriction stated (Greg’s ruling on referral- and members-only places).

kyoto_bar_bacchus_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Whisky, cocktails, wine and sake, with cheesecake, chocolate cake and pancakes; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_bar_bacchus_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks, with dried grapes and chocolate among the snacks; cakes are not vegan (reviews).
kyoto_bar_bacchus_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–02:00 Monday–Thursday, Sunday, holidays and the day after a holiday; 17:00–03:00 Friday, Saturday and holiday eves; closures are posted on Instagram, clubbacchus8 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 26 seats: counter and sofas, plus a riverside terrace with floor seating in the warmer months; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews). On Pontocho south of Sanjo, near the Kaburenjo (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_bar_bacchus_pontocho.notes: [Whisky bar · Pontocho near Sanjo, on the river] A grown-up malt bar at the north end of Pontocho with over 300 whiskies and a long cocktail list, and in summer a riverside terrace looking over the Kamo. Try a three-whisky flight (about ¥5,000); the cheesecake is a favourite. Open to 2–3 am; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened in June 2012 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2021–2025) describe a stylish Pontocho bar with counter and sofa seats, bartenders with flair and a summer terrace over the Kamo River.

anecdotes.text: A July 2022 returning guest spotted a Glenfarclas usually sold only overseas.
An April 2023 visitor sat on the floor-level terrace by the river with a small cheesecake-like appetiser.
A September 2025 second-round guest had a three-whisky flight with chocolate and dried grapes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー バッカス、バー、京都市中京区先斗町通三条下ル橋下町135 先斗町ビル1F、月〜木・日・祝日・祝日の翌日 17:00〜翌2:00、金土・祝前日 17:00〜翌3:00、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、休みはインスタグラム (clubbacchus8) で告知、26席、喫煙可、2012年6月23日オープン、国内外300種以上のウイスキー、鴨川を望むモルトバー。口コミ (2021〜2025年、英語): 先斗町の北、歌舞練場の近く、カウンターとソファ、夏は鴨川のテラス (座敷)、白州ハイボール、ポートシャーロット、海外限定のグレンファークラス、カクテルが充実、日本酒とワイン、チーズケーキ、ガトーショコラ、パンケーキ、ウイスキー3種の飲み比べとチョコとレーズンで5,000円ほど (2025年9月)、値段は高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2025.

kyoto_kushikatsu_rakuchin_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: breaded, deep-fried skewers (Tabelog menu; reviews).
kyoto_kushikatsu_rakuchin_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: most skewers are meat or seafood; a few vegetable skewers (ginkgo, sweet potato) are fried in the same oil (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_kushikatsu_rakuchin_gion.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Monday–Saturday; the kushikatsu course runs 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sunday, and Monday when it follows a holiday (Tabelog). Omakase: skewers keep coming in menu order until you say stop — about 25 in all — or order single skewers (Tabelog menu; 2016 and 2022 reviews). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). A 15-seat counter in a basement; smoking allowed (Tabelog). In the Yasaka Building basement on Kiyomoto-cho, Gion (Tabelog).
kyoto_kushikatsu_rakuchin_gion.notes: [Kushikatsu · Gion basement, omakase skewers] A fifteen-seat basement counter in Gion where a quiet veteran fries crisp, juicy kushikatsu one at a time — pork fillet, hamo, octopus, quail egg — until you say stop (about 25 in all), each with its own suggested dip. About ¥8,000–10,000; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2016–2025) describe a long-running Gion kushikatsu counter, relocated at some point, where a quiet master fries skewers swiftly in omakase order.

anecdotes.text: An August 2016 regular from Kanto had visited for about ten years, since before the move.
A November 2022 diner found about 25 skewers too many to finish.
A March 2025 guest wished the omakase let diners choose what came.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 串カツ 楽珍、串揚げ・日本料理・創作料理、京都市東山区清本町370 ヤサカビルB1F、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (串カツコースは17:00〜22:00、L.O.21:30)、日曜定休、日曜・祝日の翌月曜休み、カード可、電子マネー不可、カウンター15席、喫煙可、予算8,000〜10,000円ほど。メニュー (2021年): 串カツは1本240円から、ストップと言うまで順に出す (1本ずつの注文も可)、ご飯・赤だし・香の物のセットは800円追加、豚ヒレ、タコときゅうり、鱧の大葉巻き、海老、鳥貝、うずら卵、銀杏、牛ヒレなど。口コミ (2016〜2025年、英語): 移転前から通う客も、地下の隠れ家、寡黙なマスター、サクサクでジューシーな衣、串ごとにおすすめの味、25本ほどで多すぎるという声、選べるとよいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Omakase counter; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2025.

kyoto_baniku_ryori_itsuki.gf_detail: Ask. Horse sashimi with soy-based dips, harihari and shabu-shabu pots, rice porridge to finish; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_baniku_ryori_itsuki.hours_raw: 18:30–04:00 Monday–Saturday, holiday eves and the day after a holiday; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations recommended — only 8 counter seats (December 2024). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Heated tobacco only, ashtray at the entrance (Tabelog). A bar-like basement room with a karaoke machine (March 2026). In the Bizenya Building basement on Tominaga-cho, Gion (Tabelog).
kyoto_baniku_ryori_itsuki.notes: [Horse meat · Gion Tominaga-cho, sashimi and shabu-shabu to 4 am] An eight-seat Gion basement counter devoted to horse meat: sashimi tastings free of any gaminess, crunchy fresh liver, and futaego shabu-shabu or harihari pots finished with porridge. Open until 4 am; book ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in February 2023 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a small counter in a quiet Gion alley where a friendly chef prepares horse-meat dishes in front of guests .

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 liver lover called the horse liver the best in over twenty years.
An October 2025 business dinner watched each dish prepared at the counter.
A May 2026 first-timer had futaego shabu-shabu and found no gamey taste at all.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 馬肉料理 樹、馬肉料理・しゃぶしゃぶ、京都市東山区八坂新地富永町127 備前屋ビルB1F、月〜土・祝前日・祝日の翌日 18:30〜翌4:00、日曜・祝日定休、熊本直送の馬肉、カード可、電子マネー不可、8席、加熱式たばこのみ (入口に灰皿)、2023年2月3日オープン、予算10,000〜15,000円ほど。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 馬刺しの盛り合わせ、3種の食べ比べ、コリコリの馬レバー、はりはり鍋のコース、フタエゴのしゃぶしゃぶ、締めの雑炊、オリオンビール、日本酒、気さくな料理人、席が少ないので予約を、カラオケのあるバーのような雰囲気 (2026年3月)、2人で酒込み13,000円 (2025年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Eight-seat counter; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kinko_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and plainly grilled fish may suit, but saikyo-miso fish, simmered fish, tempura and fried squid are not wheat-free; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kinko_gojo.hours_raw: Shop: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Saturday 10:00–19:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday, announced monthly on Instagram and in the shop (Tabelog). Standing bar from 11:30, closing around 17:00; bento from 11:30 and often sold out (December 2025–October 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX), e-money and QR (Tabelog). Choose from the showcase and pay, then eat at the standing counter or take away (June 2026). At the east end of Gojo Ohashi on Route 1, by exit 4 of Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kinko_gojo.notes: [Fishmonger with standing bar · Gojo Ohashi] A fourth-generation fish shop by Gojo bridge where you pick sashimi, simmered or grilled fish from the case and eat it at the standing counter with a beer — or take away the famous saikyo-miso sablefish bento for a Kamo riverside picnic. Bento sell out; closed Wednesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a popular fresh-fish shop at the east end of Gojo Ohashi selling fresh and processed seafood and side dishes, recently with an eat-in standing corner (December 2025); an October 2026 reviewer calls it a fresh fish shop in business for four generations.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular spent over ¥10,000 in thirty minutes at the standing bar on sashimi and saikyo-miso fish to take home.
A May 2026 visitor took the ¥1,750 sablefish bento for a picnic by the Kamo, the rich fish perfect with rice and sake.
An October 2026 visitor found the famous bento sold out but enjoyed hamo tempura and sashimi with a beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 惣菜・デリ・コロッケ、東山区五条通大橋東入東橋詰町1、京阪清水五条駅4番出口すぐ、月・火・木〜土 10:00〜19:00、水・日休み (毎月 Instagram と店頭で告知)、予約不可、カード (VISA・Master・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 五条大橋の東詰の人気の鮮魚店、鮮魚・加工品・惣菜、店内の立ち飲み (11:30 から、17 時ごろまで)、ショーケースから選んで会計、銀だらの西京焼き弁当1,750円、鯖の弁当1,150円、鮭、のり弁 (11:30 から)、カンパチ・しまあじ・ひらめ・本まぐろ・やりいかの刺身、かれいの煮付け680円、まぐろのすき身580円、天ぷら、焼き鱧、焼き鯖、生ビール、熱燗、レモンサワー400円、弁当は売り切れが多い、4代続く鮮魚店との声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick from the case and pay; standing counter or take away; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_sanga_incense_cafe.gf_detail: Drinks only — scented coffees, teas and non-alcoholic drinks (2025–2026 reviews); plain coffee and tea are gluten-free, but ask about each flavouring.
kyoto_sanga_incense_cafe.vegan_detail: Drinks only; black coffee and tea are plant-based, but chai and some drinks may use milk — ask (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sanga_incense_cafe.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money (iD, QUICPay) and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) (Tabelog). Seven seats looking onto a courtyard; two signature coffees are for drinking in only, the rest can be taken away (Tabelog; September 2025). An incense maker's shop in a townhouse described as 120 years old, moved here from Goshonai (November 2025). Yanaginobamba below Oike; 5 min walk from Karasuma-Oike or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 August 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sanga_incense_cafe.notes: [Scent café · Yanaginobamba-Oike, townhouse] An incense maker's townhouse shop with a seven-seat café over a courtyard, serving coffee and drinks blended with edible natural aromatics — smell the testers, then sip a "Gourmand" ice coffee or chai while the staff explain the scents. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: Sanga Incense, an incense brand "that satisfies curiosity through scent", moved from Goshonai into a renovated Kyoto townhouse (said to be 120 years old) and opened this café, the Shiko Inryo Kenkyujo main store, in 2025 (Tabelog: 22 August 2025); its natural incense comes in 18 scents (November 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Curiosity satisfied through scent (November 2025).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor sampled the scented coffees, then took one of the two drink-in-only specials to the courtyard view.
A March 2026 first-of-the-day guest had the room to themselves with jazz playing, and found the coffee as good as a specialty roaster's.
A May 2026 visitor found the smoky, herbal "absinthe (myrrh)" more a scent to savour than a juice — not for everyone.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、中京区柳馬場通御池下ル柳八幡町77、烏丸御池駅3-1出口・市役所前駅8番出口から徒歩5分、月・火・木〜日・祝日 11:00〜18:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・電子マネー (iD・QUICPay)・QR (PayPay・楽天ペイ・Alipay・WeChat Pay) 可、7席、2025年8月22日開店。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 香のブランド「サンガインセンス」の店内のカフェ、Goshonai から移転、築120年の町家を改装 (2025年11月)、天然素材の香18種、食べられる天然の香料を合わせたコーヒー、ダークローストの豆、「Gourmand」、店内限定の「Special 2」、高カフェインのコーヒー、香りのお茶、チャイのアイス800円、「Absinthe (Myrrh)」、ノンアルコールのドリンク、テスターで香りを確かめる、中庭、ていねいな説明。

cultural_comfort.note: Seven seats; staff explain each scent; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened August 2025; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_fuuunji_teramachi.gf_detail: Not GF: karaage, gyoza, tempura and chijimi (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_fuuunji_teramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, fugu, hamo and chicken (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_fuuunji_teramachi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closing days irregular (Tabelog). Reviewers also describe weekday lunch sets popular with City Hall staff (July 2023; May 2025) — lunch hours are not on Tabelog. Reservations accepted; the whole-hamo course is limited, so book (August 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 29 seats at the counter, tables and a tatami room (Tabelog; January 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; February 2026). Tomitaya building 1F on Teramachi above Oike, facing City Hall; about 120 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_fuuunji_teramachi.notes: [Izakaya · Teramachi-Oike, opposite City Hall] A homely, Showa-style izakaya facing City Hall: fugu courses in winter, a whole-hamo course in summer, and everyday favourites — omelette, gyoza, chijimi, grilled tuna — with hot sake. Smoking allowed. City Hall staff come for weekday lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a casual, homely Japanese izakaya in front of Kyoto City Hall, with lunch sets popular with city staff and seasonal courses of fugu and hamo (2023–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular celebrated the start of the fugu season: torafugu sashimi, grilled fugu, hot pot and zosui to finish.
An August 2026 pair shared the whole-hamo course — sashimi, seared, tempura, bone crackers and shabu-shabu — the only hamo of the day.
A February 2026 pair came in from the cold for hot sake, found the cigarette smoke off-putting at first, and settled in at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区寺町通御池上ル上本能寺町484 トミタヤビル 1F、市役所前から115m、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、不定休、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、29席、喫煙可。口コミ (2023年7月〜2026年8月、英語): 市役所の向かい、平日の昼は市役所の職員に人気の定食 (日替わり、唐揚げ、まぐろの刺身)、冬はとらふぐの刺身・焼きふぐ・鍋・雑炊、夏は鱧一本のコース (造り、焼き霜、天ぷら、骨せんべい、しゃぶしゃぶ)、玉ねぎ・にんにく・岩塩のまぐろの炙り、卵焼き、唐揚げ、淡路の玉ねぎ餃子、海鮮チヂミ、たこの唐揚げ、たこのポン酢焼き、ぶりの造り、焼酎、熱燗、座敷あり、昭和の気取らない居酒屋、たばこのにおい (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed; homely counter and tatami; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_kazamidori_karasuma_rokkaku.gf_detail: Not GF: karaage, tare yakitori, chanko and zosui (2018–2024 reviews).
kyoto_kazamidori_karasuma_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, sashimi and hot pot (2018–2024 reviews).
kyoto_kazamidori_karasuma_rokkaku.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); open all year, with occasional unexpected closures — phone ahead (Tabelog). Reservations by the day before; changes after confirmation incur cancellation fees; you may be seated at the counter (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥440 per person, not on courses (Tabelog original 席料お1人様 440円 ※コース注文時は除く). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). Semi-private room including the counter for groups; bring-your-own allowed (February 2025). Smoking allowed (June 2024). Daiki Rokkaku building 1F, Rokkaku east of Karasuma; 3–5 min walk from Karasuma-Oike, Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 16 February 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kazamidori_karasuma_rokkaku.notes: [Yakitori izakaya · Karasuma-Rokkaku, till 1 a.m.] A late-opening yakitori izakaya near Karasuma, popular for group parties: all-you-can-drink courses of sashimi, yakitori, karaage and chanko hot pot. Book by the day before; ¥440 seat charge à la carte. Smoking allowed. Some 2024 reviewers found the course portions thin.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakitori and creative izakaya opened 16 February 2011 on Rokkaku east of Karasuma, open all year until late, taking group bookings.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 year-end party had chanko, karaage and sashimi with quick drink service and strong drinks.
A February 2025 large group was given a semi-private area including the counter, with bring-your-own allowed.
A July 2024 group on the premium all-you-can-drink course found one skewer of yakitori each too little.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・焼き鳥・創作料理、中京区六角通烏丸東入ル堂之前町230-2 大輝六角ビル 1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.0:30)、年中無休 (臨時休業あり、事前に確認を)、予約は前日まで、確定後の変更やキャンセルは料金がかかる、カウンターになることも、席料1人440円 (コースは除く)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・電子マネー・QR 可、2011年2月16日開店。口コミ (2018年11月〜2025年10月、英語): 飲み放題付きのコース4,000円ほど (サラダ、刺身の盛り合わせ、唐揚げ、レバーの焼き鳥、揚げ出し豆腐、ぶり大根、鍋、雑炊)、ちゃんこ鍋、喫煙可 (2024年6月)、持ち込み可 (2025年2月)、焼き鳥が少ないとの声と早く帰るよう促されたとの声 (2024年)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥440 seat charge à la carte; book by the day before; smoking allowed; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2025.

kyoto_dublin_irish_pub.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an Irish pub menu of fish and chips, shepherd's pie, garlic toast, fried oysters, pasta and pizza (2025–2026 reviews); beers include Guinness and other barley beers.
kyoto_dublin_irish_pub.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and chips, shepherd's pie, salami, smoked duck, steak. Edamame, nuts and a carrot salad were also ordered (2025–2026 reviews) — ask.
kyoto_dublin_irish_pub.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:00–2:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 24:00); Sun and holidays 16:00–1:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 23:00); open all year; hours may change on the day. Happy hour until 19:00 with ¥200 off draft beer (2026 reviews). Reservations taken. Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original reads 「なし」 (none), though its English page says one may be added — ask. 94 seats over two floors (counter and tables downstairs, 60 upstairs); parties up to 100. Smoking allowed. Cards, PayPay, Alipay. English and Korean menus and staff. Live music and sports on screens. By exit 2 of Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae, next to Hotel Okura Kyoto (2026 reviews). Opened 1 August 2010.
kyoto_dublin_irish_pub.notes: [Irish pub · Oike by Kyoto City Hall, a two-floor pub] A roomy Irish pub right at the City Hall subway exit, open to 2 am: Guinness and Urquell on draft, Irish whiskey, fish and chips and shepherd's pie, with a 19:00 happy hour and a big mixed crowd of locals and travellers. About ¥2,000–4,000. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe polite, friendly staff, a calm first floor and party groups upstairs, and about half the customers from overseas (2025–2026). Criticism: soggy fish batter and a pie without pastry (July 2025); noise from a large group (January 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Guinness and draft beers; fish and chips.

anecdotes.text: September 2025: "I enjoyed a Guinness while savoring some traditional fish and chips! I was delighted to find that it was very close to the authentic style."
October 2026: "From 6 to 7 PM, they have a happy hour with great prices on both beer and food. I sat at the counter and enjoyed a relaxing time watching the Japan Series."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダブリン、パブ・ビアホール・ビアバー、中京区御池通り河原町東入ル一之船入町537-23 ミレニアム御池ビル1F・2F、地下鉄東西線京都市役所前駅2番出口の前、月〜土17:00〜翌2:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.24:00)、日・祝日16:00〜翌1:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.23:00)、年中無休、予約可、サービス料の原文は「なし」、94席 (1階カウンター8・テーブル20、2階60)、100名までのパーティー、喫煙可、カード・PayPay・Alipay可、英語・韓国語のメニューとスタッフ、ライブ音楽、スポーツ観戦、2010年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): フィッシュ&チップス小780円、シェパーズパイ1,200円、ベイリーズミルク800円、アイリッシュハイボール700円〜、ピルスナーウルケル1,400円 (ハッピーアワー1,200円)、IchijojiブリュワリーのIPA 1,350円、ギネス、19時までのハッピーアワー、客の半分ほどが海外の人、ホテルオークラ京都の隣、衣がしんなりとの声 (2025年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Korean menus and staff (Tabelog); many overseas guests. Smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August, September and October 2026.

kyoto_akari_karasuma_plaza.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: party buffets and courses with kara-age, pasta and soba (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_akari_karasuma_plaza.vegan_detail: Not vegan: buffets with ham, kara-age and pork (August 2025). An April 2026 course leaned on vegetables — ask.
kyoto_akari_karasuma_plaza.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 14:00–23:00, by reservation only — confirm numbers at least three days ahead; hours can be adjusted by phone; closed on irregular days. Built for private hire: 10 seats for small groups on weekdays (by consultation), up to 100 seated or 120 standing for parties; a whole private floor. Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original reads 「無し」 (none), though its English page says one is added — ask. Designated smoking area. Cards, IC, e-money and QR. Children welcome, with a kids' menu. Projector, screen and microphones. At the back of B1F of カラスマプラザ21, east side of Karasuma south of Rokkaku; 3 min from Karasuma, Shijo or Karasuma-Oike stations.
kyoto_akari_karasuma_plaza.notes: [Party venue & dining bar · Karasuma south of Rokkaku, a chandeliered basement hall] A hidden basement hall near Shijo-Karasuma with a soaring ceiling, chandelier and screen, booked for wedding after-parties and work dos: buffets or courses with all-you-can-drink from about ¥4,000–5,000. Reservation only; small groups on weekdays by arrangement.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog presents it as a private-hire venue for receptions and parties. Reviewers describe friendly staff, a chef who cooked a small-group course alone (April 2026), and beer poured from the bottom of the glass (September 2023). Criticism: the buffet was crowded and chaotic at a large party (June 2026); it felt more like renting a space than dining out (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Party courses and buffets with all-you-can-drink.

anecdotes.text: September 2023: "The atmosphere is perfect for after-parties, like wedding receptions, and it features a projector and sound system. The high ceilings and beautiful chandeliers create a stunning space."
April 2026: "The chef was working solo, serving each dish in a timely manner, and everything went very smoothly—it was impressive."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 灯 (AKARI)、ダイニングバー・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区烏丸通六角下ル東側 カラスマプラザ21 B1奥、烏丸御池駅・四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日14:00〜23:00、完全予約制 (人数は3日前までに確定)、時間は電話で相談可、不定休、平日は少人数も相談可、最大着席100名・立食120名、フロア貸切、サービス料の原文は「無し」、分煙、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、子供可・キッズメニュー、プロジェクター・マイク、公式サイト merry-and-marry.jp、天井高6メートルとシャンデリア、飲み放題付きのコース4,000円〜。口コミ (2019年7月〜2026年6月、英語): 飲み放題付き5,000円のコース (約9品、2023年9月)、ハム・唐揚げ・豚肉・パスタのビュッフェ (2025年8月)、締めのそばとさつまいもご飯 (2025年11月)、野菜中心のコース (2026年4月)、二次会や送別会に、ビュッフェが混雑との声 (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; mostly group parties.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated April and June 2026.

kyoto_nikutei_yuhi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: meat kaiseki and yakiniku courses with menchi katsu, beef stew, curry and sauces (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nikutei_yuhi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu courses — Ozaki and Hirai beef, tongue, horumon, meat sushi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nikutei_yuhi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken. Cards and PayPay. 32 seats: a 1st-floor counter for meat kaiseki and 2nd-floor private rooms (four for 6, one for 8; sunken seating; shoes off) for yakiniku courses (2025 reviews). Non-smoking. Sommelier on staff. Children welcome (strollers left on the 1st floor). East of Hotel Okura Kyoto near Kiyamachi-Oike (August 2026 review); 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae exit 2. Opened 2 August 2022. Operator 株式会社YSI (NTA invoice register).
kyoto_nikutei_yuhi.notes: [Wagyu kaiseki & yakiniku · Kiyamachi-Oike near City Hall, a townhouse with private rooms] Ozaki and Kyoto Hirai beef served two ways: as meat kaiseki at a 1st-floor counter, or as yakiniku courses in shoes-off private rooms upstairs, with a sommelier and a rice course worth seconds. About ¥10,000–20,000. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Operator: 株式会社YSI (NTA invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 2 August 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a refined, calm modern-Japanese interior, a chef who explains each dish at the counter, friendly staff who print guests' names on the course menu and take photos, and birthday plates. Criticism: small portions (August 2026); the place is slightly off its map pin (June 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Ozaki and Hirai wagyu; meat kaiseki; yakiniku courses.

anecdotes.text: May 2025: "The counter offers a meat kaiseki experience, while the private rooms feature yakiniku. You can choose a course based on your purpose of visit."
February 2025: "The rice served at the end was absolutely delicious. It was made with Yamagata's premium rice… I ended up having six servings!"

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off for the upstairs private rooms; counter or private-room courses.

kyoto_kappobar_doi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kappo courses with tempura, okowa and dashi-simmered dishes (2017 review), and eel shabu-shabu in eel-bone broth (2018).
kyoto_kappobar_doi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood-led kappo — sashimi, smoked mackerel, karasumi, duck, sea-urchin rice (2011–2018 reviews).
kyoto_kappobar_doi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sunday and some irregular days — book before visiting. Lunch for groups of six or more by reservation. The chef cooks alone, so courses must be booked by the day before; same-day course cancellations are charged 100%. Service charge 5%, no cover — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料５％ チャージ料なし」. Cards (VISA, Master). 27 seats: 16 tatami, 4 sunken, 7 counter; semi-private rooms; private hire up to 50. Non-smoking (ashtray outside). Children welcome; the tatami room is recommended for them. In the narrow alley beside the Lawson at Higashiyama Yasui, south of Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog).
kyoto_kappobar_doi.notes: [Kappo · Higashiyama Yasui near Yasaka Shrine, a dance master's house down an alley] A relaxed kappo in a renovated dance-practice house — the old hinoki stage is still there — where the owner-chef cooks seasonal fish, yuba rice and eel shabu-shabu and pours good sake and natural wine. Courses from ¥6,600 plus 5% service. Book a day ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog says the house was a Japanese dance master's home, transformed by the American architect Jeffrey Moussas (romaji as given), and that the chef now prepares everything by himself. A 2010 reviewer calls it run by a lovely couple and a 2013 reviewer mentions the owner and his wife; 2011 reviewers note the hinoki stage once used for maiko and geiko practice and occasional maiko events (2011; 2017). Reviewers praise a knowledgeable, accommodating chef and well-matched sake and wine. Criticism: "not exactly cheap" (2013). The newest review is from February 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish kappo; fresh-yuba rice; sake and natural wine.

anecdotes.text: December 2018: "As winter is in full swing, I visited Master Doi's Kappo Bar Doi to try his recommended dish, 'Unagi Shabu'."
January 2012: "Upon entering, to the left, there is a hinoki wood stage, which I've been told was converted from the home of a dance teacher."

kyoto_kinryu_takatsuji.notes: [Chinese · Takatsuji near Karasuma, ¥980 sets] A no-frills Chinese restaurant on Takatsuji with tables and tatami, run by native-speaking staff: generous ¥980 lunch sets like black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork or mapo tofu, Sichuan dan dan noodles, fried rice and dumplings, and banquet dishes at night.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular, back after eleven months, notes there are few places nearby with sets or noodles under ¥1,000.

No service charge or cover (Tabelog, original サービス料、チャージ不要). Cards, IC and QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). 25 seats: 5 at the counter and 20 at tables (Tabelog). On the ground floor of 四条烏丸スタービル, 3 min from Shijo/Karasuma (Tabelog).
kyoto_chotto_bar_gotsubo.notes: [Shochu bar and café · Shijo-Karasuma] A friendly bar-café with over 100 shochu from across Japan, where staff pour and explain from the bottles behind the counter; Miyazaki charcoal-grilled chicken and cheese to snack on, and coffee, cakes and kakigori for the café crowd. No cover charge; closed Tuesday. Flagged: the second shop of a bar in Yamato-Yagi, Nara.

chef_bio.background: An August 2025 reviewer calls it the second shop of a popular bar in Yamato-Yagi, Nara. Reviewers describe a friendly master and staff who introduce shochu from the bottles behind the counter (December 2025, March 2026).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor mixed a tea-flavoured shochu with milk and found it like unsweetened milk tea, perfect with chocolate cake.

kyoto_berry_button_gojo.notes: [Café · Kawaramachi-Gojo, Korean-style financiers] A busy Korean-style café and bakery where people queue for colourful financiers — fig and cream cheese, salty chocolate, hojicha and matcha tigres — and cream lattes, to eat in or take away; go early, as favourites sell out by mid-afternoon. anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor staying nearby joined a queue outside at 3 pm and found the Earl Grey financier already sold out.
An October 2026 regular, visiting for the first time since the move, called the fig-cream-cheese financier with a café latte an ideal break.

kyoto_teppan_izakaya_gion_wa.notes: [Teppan izakaya · east Gion, since 2019] A small third-floor teppan counter in the eastern part of Gion where a laid-back master cooks okonomiyaki, the house "Ebisu-yaki", modern-yaki, negiyaki and Omi beef steak in front of you, plus cheese dashimaki and grilled horumon. An October 2025 visitor wondered whether Kyoto okonomiyaki might outdo Osaka after the mixed modern-yaki.

Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 26 seats incl. a counter and a shoes-off upstairs room (Tabelog; July 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Entry limited to university students and older (September 2025). Hidden in a back alley off Karasuma-dori east of Bukkoji, 2 min from Shijo exit 5 — call if lost (Tabelog).
kyoto_ufufu_bis_bukkoji.notes: [Japanese-Western izakaya · Karasuma-Bukkoji] A hidden izakaya down a back alley near Shijo station, around for about 15 years, with a counter and a shoes-off room upstairs, mixing Japanese dishes with Western ones: yuba gyoza, corn tempura, chicken and kimchi rolls, sashimi, ajillo, pasta and pizza. Adults only (university age and up); one November 2025 group found portions small for sharing. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya hidden in a back alley near Shijo for about 15 years.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular keeps coming back for the yuba gyoza and the chicken and kimchi rolls.
A July 2025 reunion group went shoes-off upstairs, recommending the corn tempura.
A February 2026 returnee felt immediately at home at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・野菜料理、下京区烏丸通仏光寺東入ル一筋目上ル、地下鉄四条駅5番出口から徒歩2分、月〜土17:00〜24:00、日曜 (祝日は営業) と第3月曜休み、カード可、26席、喫煙可、路地裏で15年。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年6月、英語): 湯葉餃子、ささみとキムチの巻き寿司、焼き鳥、ペペロンチーノ、とうもろこしの天ぷら、大根の揚げ物、2階は靴を脱ぐ、アヒージョ、パスタ、ピザ、ハンバーグ、シマアジと焼き鱧の刺身、大学生以上のみ、量は少なめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find — call if lost (Tabelog); adults only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_menbo_shijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an udon shop; every set comes with a small udon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_menbo_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon broth, aji fry, grilled pork, bonito tataki (2026 reviews).
kyoto_menbo_shijo.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–22:30; Sat–Sun 11:30–22:30; closed 31 December and 1 January (Tabelog). Online reservations, incl. same day (November 2026). Cash and QR (PayPay; Rakuten Pay added by October 2026); no cards or e-money (Tabelog; October 2026). 36 seats: counter, tables and sunken kotatsu (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Kyoto Mitsui Building B1F at Shijo-Karasuma, 1 min from Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_menbo_shijo.notes: [Udon · Shijo-Karasuma] A busy, good-value udon shop in the basement of the Kyoto Mitsui Building at Shijo-Karasuma, with a long menu of set meals — Tosa bonito tataki, aji fry, grilled-pork bowl — each with a small udon, plus yuba ankake and oroshi bukkake udon. Open daily to 22:30; quick service; PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an udon restaurant in the Kyoto Mitsui Building basement, popular since before the pandemic; a sister めん坊 is listed in Osaka Tenjinbashi.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner found a generous bonito tataki in the ¥1,300 Tosa set with a small udon.
An October 2026 lunch-seeker escaped the Kyoto Station crowds for the quieter Mitsui Building basement.
A November 2026 diner booked online the same day and was seated at once despite a queue.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん・食堂・うどんすき、下京区四条通烏丸東入長刀鉾町8 京都三井ビル B1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩1分、月〜金11:00〜22:30、土日11:30〜22:30、12月31日・1月1日休み、現金・PayPay、36席 (カウンター、テーブル、掘りごたつ)、禁煙、車椅子可。口コミ (2026年3月〜11月、英語): 土佐定食 (かつおのたたきと温泉卵) 1,300円、焼豚丼、あじフライ定食1,150円、どの定食にも小うどん、おろしぶっかけうどん、湯葉あんかけうどん1,000円、当日のネット予約、Rakuten Pay も可に。

cultural_comfort.note: Set meals are the easy order; book online at busy times. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_hananoi_sushi_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi, sashimi and grilled fish with soy and saikyo miso; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_hananoi_sushi_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi restaurant built on fish and shellfish (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_hananoi_sushi_gion.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday; closes early when the day’s fish runs out (Tabelog). No printed menu — say what you would like, or take the omakase (April 2024; April and October 2025). Reservations taken; the counter can be fully booked (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Counter, a tatami room and private rooms for 4 and 6; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the south side of Gion near Hanamikoji (Tabelog; 2021 and 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hananoi_sushi_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion south, no-menu counter] A calm, old-style Gion sushi counter with no menu: ask for what you like or go omakase — sashimi, saikyo-miso grilled fish, then light, Kansai-style nigiri. The chef speaks English; private rooms too. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A Gion sushi restaurant reviewed since 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2021–2026) describe a calm counter much used by regulars, a friendly chef who speaks English, and the chef’s cheerful mother in the dining room.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 regular noted the English-speaking chef and the foreign guests at the counter.
A May 2024 diner who had never liked eel could not put down the chopsticks here.
An August 2026 first-timer was seated in the back private room; the counter was already full.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 花の井、寿司・日本料理、京都市東山区祇園町南側570-120-4、火〜日 17:00〜23:00、月曜定休、ネタがなくなり次第閉店、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー不可、カウンター・座敷・個室 (4名、6名)、禁煙、予算10,000〜15,000円ほど。口コミ (2014〜2026年、英語): メニューのない寿司屋で食べたいものを伝えるかおまかせ、刺身の盛り合わせ、鰆や銀だらの西京焼き、蟹、土瓶蒸し、鯛・鰆・鱚・烏賊・帆立・雲丹・車海老・中トロの握り、鉄火巻と雲丹烏賊巻、米酢のやさしい甘さのシャリ、京都の蛸、白味噌の味噌汁、鰻、英語を話す大将、明るいお母さん、常連の多い落ち着いた店、カウンターは予約で満席のことも。

cultural_comfort.note: The chef speaks English (April 2025 review); no printed menu.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_gion_ushi_akari.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled wagyu with sauces and dashi; the courses include Echizen soba and a steak sandwich; no gluten information is published (tabiiro menu; reviews).
kyoto_gion_ushi_akari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu restaurant (Tabelog; official listings).
kyoto_gion_ushi_akari.hours_raw: 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–23:00 Monday–Saturday and holidays; closed Sunday and the first and third Monday of the month; holiday hours may vary (Tabelog). Opened 22 July 2026 (Tabelog review). Reservations by phone or TableCheck (Tabelog; TableCheck). Cards including UnionPay accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 14 seats: an 8-seat counter and a private room for 2–6; non-smoking; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the Gion Shirakawa HK Building, Sueyoshi-cho (tabiiro).
kyoto_gion_ushi_akari.notes: [Wagyu · Gion Shirakawa, charcoal-grill meat kappo] A new (July 2026) machiya counter where rare Manyo beef is cut in front of you and grilled over charcoal, with Fukui sweet shrimp and Echizen soba from the chef’s home prefecture. Dinner courses from ¥16,500; lunch from about ¥3,000. English menu; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in Gion on 22 July 2026 (Tabelog review). A cook from Fukui Prefecture who has worked with wagyu for many years (tabiiro); an October 2026 reviewer puts it at 25 years. The representative visits the producers and buys Manyo beef through a long relationship with HANAFUSA in Tottori (tabiiro).
chef_bio.philosophy: To bring the good food and sake of Fukui to Kyoto, and to "light up the beef", as the name says (tabiiro; August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 opening-week guest was sent home with onigiri made from the leftover clay-pot rice.
An August 2026 food blogger listed a ¥22,000 Manyo sirloin course ending in clay-pot rice with beef tendon and Tanba beans.
An October 2026 celebration in the private room came with a cake, a bouquet and a Polaroid.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 牛あかり、ステーキ・海鮮・肉料理、京都市東山区末吉町82-7、月〜土・祝日・祝前日・祝日の翌日 11:00〜14:00、18:00〜23:00、日曜定休、第1・第3月曜休み、祝日と祝前日は営業時間が変わることも、カード可 (銀聯も)、電子マネー・QR決済不可、サービス料10%、14席 (カウンター8席、個室1室 2〜6名)、禁煙、英語メニュー・英語の話せるスタッフ、子供可。旅色: 祇園白川HKビル1F、純血但馬血統の万葉牛を主役にした肉割烹、鳥取の HANAFUSA から仕入れ、代表が生産地へ足を運ぶ、長年和牛と向き合ってきた職人、六鍋製の特注炉の炭火焼き、福井県出身の料理人で福井の食材と日本酒、福井越前の十割おろしそば1,800円、万葉牛のステーキサンド3,500円、万葉牛サーロイン100g 8,500円、フィレ100g 14,500円、シャトーブリアン100g 20,000円、町家の空間と個室。TableCheck: 炭火焼肉、コース16,500円・22,000円・38,500円 (サービス料別)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 2026年7月22日オープン、目の前で切り分けて炭火で焼く、タンとハラミの刺身、福井の甘海老、万葉牛サーロインのコース22,000円、土鍋ご飯、残ったご飯をおにぎりに、ランチは3,000円ほど、和牛ひと筋25年の料理人、記念日の個室。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog, TableCheck and tabiiro listings; opened July 2026; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tsudaro_hanamikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kaiseki with dashi and soy, and wheat-gluten (fu) in some soups; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_tsudaro_hanamikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki built on fish such as hamo and dashi (reviews).
kyoto_tsudaro_hanamikoji.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00; dinner 17:00–19:00; bar 17:00–midnight (official site; Tabelog gives dinner 17:00–22:00 with last food order 19:00). Closed Wednesday and the third Tuesday, with further closing days posted each month on the official site — for November 2026: 4, 5, 10, 11, 17, 18, 25, 29 and 30 November (official site). Reservations by phone only, 13:00–18:00; cancellation the business day before is charged 50% (to 17:00) or 100% (official site). No under-18s at dinner (Tabelog). Bar: charge from ¥2,000 a person, plus 10% service and 10% tax; a room for the bar ¥4,000–5,000; geiko and maiko can be arranged (official site). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 10% service included in meal prices (Tabelog). Non-smoking throughout; counter seats, and chairs can be set in the tatami rooms on request (official site). Shoes off at the door (October 2024). On Hanamikoji south of Shijo, west side, diagonally opposite the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo (official site).
kyoto_tsudaro_hanamikoji.notes: [Kaiseki & bar · Hanamikoji, Taisho-era teahouse] A former Gion ochaya on Hanamikoji, its dance hall and courtyard intact, now serving seasonal kaiseki on antique Meiji and Taisho porcelain, with a bar at a single-plank zelkova counter till midnight. Lunch about ¥6,600. Phone to book; closed Wednesdays and other days posted monthly.

roles: Head chef not named; owner 村田理如 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Tsudaro ran as an ochaya from the end of the Edo period and moved to Hanamikoji in the early Taisho era; with no successor the building was at risk, and the collector 村田理如 took it on as owner in 2010, keeping it as a Gion restaurant and bar (official site). An October 2024 reviewer reports a renovation and reopening that September, with the same head chef and the chef’s wife as okami.
chef_bio.philosophy: To pass on Gion and Kyoto culture through all five senses — seasonal scrolls and settings, dishes on collected tableware, and ozashiki entertainment with geiko and maiko (official site).

anecdotes.text: A January 2023 regular noticed the eel-and-catfish crest, a nod to the house’s origins supplying river fish in Yamashina.
An October 2024 couple left shoes at the noren and lunched at the first-floor counter facing the courtyard.
An April 2023 after-party drank champagne upstairs to the sound of a bamboo flute.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 津田楼、幕末よりお茶屋を営み、大正初期に花見小路へ移る、芸妓・舞妓の舞のための広い踊り場、東山三十六峰を写した欄間、酒井田柿右衛門・今泉今右衛門・清水卯一など明治から大正期の器、欅の一枚板のカウンター、花見小路四条下ル西側 祇園甲部歌舞練場斜め前、ランチ12:00〜14:00、ディナー17:00〜19:00、バー17:00〜深夜、水曜・第3火曜定休、毎月の休業日をお知らせで告知 (2026年11月は4・5・10・11・17・18・25・29・30日)、予約は電話のみ (13:00〜18:00)、前営業日17時までのキャンセルは50%、それ以降は100%、バーのチャージ1人2,000円から、サービス料10%と消費税別、バーで部屋を指定すると室料4,000〜5,000円、尺八の演奏、舞妓・芸妓・地方の手配、全館禁煙、座敷に高座椅子、オーナー村田理如が2010年に新しい津田楼を始める、器や軸は村田のコレクション。食べログ: 津田楼、日本料理、祇園町南側570-121、カード可、電子マネー・QR決済不可、サービス料10% (料金に含む)、32席、個室、禁煙、ディナーは18歳未満不可、インボイス T5130003002950 (合同会社津田樓)。口コミ (2019〜2025年、英語): 大正のお茶屋を改装した会席、鰻と鯰の巴の紋は山科で川魚を商った名残、一枚板のカウンター、中庭、2階から花見小路、鱧づくし、かますの照り焼き、生姜と油揚げの炊き込みご飯、ランチ6,600円 (2024年10月)、2024年9月に改装して再開、料理長は続投で妻が女将に、靴を脱いで上がる、二次会にバー利用。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone 13:00–18:00; shoes off; geiko and maiko can be arranged.

existence.note: Official site posting closing days through December 2026; Tabelog reviews dated through July 2025.
