kyoto_yamatomi_yanagibaba.gf_detail: Ask. Oden in bonito dashi, kushiage, tempura and grilled dishes; dashi and soy are used throughout and no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_yamatomi_yanagibaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the bonito dashi runs through the menu, oden included (official site).
kyoto_yamatomi_yanagibaba.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Reservations through the official site or by phone (official site; Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX) accepted (official site). A small izakaya with a long counter; easy for solo diners (official site; November 2024). In a lane at Yanagibaba-Rokkaku (official site).
kyoto_yamatomi_yanagibaba.notes: [Oden izakaya · Yanagibaba-Rokkaku, the old Pontocho Yamatomi] The Pontocho riverside izakaya long loved by locals and students, reopened in a quiet lane with the same okami at the counter: Kyoto-style oden in light bonito dashi, kushiage, hamo-skin with cucumber and bite-size onigiri at fair prices. Easy alone; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Formerly an izakaya on Pontocho above Shijo, known for its riverside yuka seating and loved by locals and students; it closed for a time and reopened at Yanagibaba-Rokkaku, with the okami still running it (official site; July 2024 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Unpretentious but refined: the season on the plate, at prices that keep long-time fans (official site).

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 regular from the Pontocho days was delighted to find the okami still behind the counter at the new address.
An April 2026 traveller ordered the bite-size onigiri — six small rolls of ume, salmon and bonito flakes.
A November 2024 solo diner praised the gentle dashi and the friendly okami.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 山とみ、京都市中京区柳馬場六角下る井筒屋町421、懐石と京おでん、平成の時代に先斗町で愛された味と心を受け継ぎ移転して再び暖簾を掲げる、かつて先斗町・四条上ルにあり川床でも知られた居酒屋、一時閉店を経て柳馬場六角で再開、女将が健在、鰹出汁の薄味の京料理、おでん・串揚げ・はも皮きゅうり・生麩の味噌田楽、旬の天ぷらと焼き物、明るく清潔なカウンターの小さな居酒屋、1人でも気軽に、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、水曜休み、カード可 (JCB、AMEX)、予約はサイトから。食べログ: 山とみ、日本料理、月・火・木〜日 17:00〜22:00、水曜定休。口コミ (2012〜2026年、英語): おでんの盛り合わせ880円、串揚げの盛り合わせ850円、はも皮きゅうり730円、小さなおにぎり950円 (2024年11月)、若竹の煮物1,100円、ロールキャベツ440円 (2026年4月)、出汁のやさしい味、気さくな女将、先斗町時代からの常連、地元の年配の客が多い、天ぷらと焼き物も好評。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter izakaya with regulars; book via the official site.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_yamatomi_yanagibaba.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260203/26033043/ (35.006523, 135.764172), offset ~1m to clear おだしと日本酒 せつ (8.1m); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区井筒屋町421番地 (lot) 31m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_shinka_ebisucho.gf_detail: Ask. A creative Japanese course with sauces, noodles and broths (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shinka_ebisucho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hairy crab, caviar, sea bream, venison, duck (August 2026 review).
kyoto_shinka_ebisucho.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and the days around holidays 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesdays (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog Japanese original 「サービス料10％」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats at an open kitchen; non-smoking (Tabelog; July 2026 review). 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog).
kyoto_shinka_ebisucho.notes: [Innovative Japanese · Kawaramachi-Sanjo] An eight-seat open-kitchen counter, the Kyoto shop of Tokyo's Azabu Asai, serving playful seasonal courses — hairy crab with gazpacho, venison, duck miso noodles — with wine. Michelin-listed within its first year (2026 reviews). About ¥15,000–30,000 plus 10%.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 January 2026 (Tabelog) as a new shop of Azabu Asai of Tokyo (February 2026 review), on the site where Obase used to be (October 2026 review). A staff of two (October 2026 review). Listed in the Michelin Guide (August and October 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto flavours with the essence of Azabu (February 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner took the Summer Evening Course; the green-tomato gazpacho with hairy crab and caviar stood out for its sharp acidity.
An October 2026 visitor recognised the front from an earlier visit to Obase, which used to be on the same site.
A July 2026 diner found a new Kyoto favourite at the open-kitchen counter, surprised until the last dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 真華、日本料理・フレンチ・イノベーティブ、中京区恵比須町534-39 1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木・金・祝日の前日・祝日の翌日 17:00〜23:00、土日・祝日 12:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、水曜休み、サービス料10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席、禁煙、2026年1月7日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 東京の Azabu Asai の京都の店、京都の食材、ワインのペアリング、夏の夜のコース (hamo ととうもろこし、毛蟹とキャビアの青トマトのガスパチョ、sweet sea bream と sudachi、北海道の鹿、Kamo なす、京都の鴨の肉味噌の太い somen)、ミシュランガイド掲載、以前は Obase の場所、スタッフ2人。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter course; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_steak_house_hanamoto_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak may suit, but the steak bowl sauce and miso soup are unknown (2025 reviews).
kyoto_steak_house_hanamoto_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: steak, egg, clam miso soup (2025 reviews).
kyoto_steak_house_hanamoto_gion.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays (Tabelog). Lunch is the steak bowl only (2025 reviews). Service charge 10% at dinner only (Tabelog Japanese original 「ディナーのみサービス料10%」). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 5 at the counter and 3 tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). 2nd floor of a building down a narrow alley off Shijo near Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog; June 2025 review).
kyoto_steak_house_hanamoto_gion.notes: [Teppanyaki · Gion] A small second-floor teppanyaki in a Gion back alley with one chef at the plate: a good-value ¥2,000 steak bowl at lunch and steak dinners from about ¥10,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 11 July 2023 (Tabelog). The master started out in Ginza and came back to Gion (July 2023 pre-opening review); a November 2023 review credits the chef with 25 years at the teppan in Ginza, Tokyo. One male chef runs the place solo (November 2023 and June 2025 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner came for the steak bowl, heard it had risen from ¥1,500 to ¥2,000, and found the chef started cooking without asking — lunch is one dish.
A September 2025 diner found plenty of cut steak under the fried egg, with clam miso soup and ice cream.
A November 2024 dinner guest had the tenderloin course — prosciutto salad, scallops, steak, rice and clam miso soup, yuzu sorbet — and heard from the master that the room usually fills around 8 pm.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: STEAK HOUSE 花本、鉄板焼き、東山区祇園町北側282-21 祇園ビル2F、祇園四条駅7番出口から八坂神社方面、火〜日 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、月曜休み、ディナーのみサービス料10%、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、16席 (カウンター5、テーブル3)、禁煙、2023年7月11日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2025年、英語): 昼はステーキ丼のみ2,000円 (1,500円から値上げ)、目玉焼きの下にカットステーキ、赤玉ねぎとハーブ、サラダ、あさりの味噌汁、アイス、夜は1万円ほどから、料理人はひとり (2025年)、銀座で25年の経歴 (2023年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small teppan counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated June and September 2025.

kyoto_bone_sai_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Strawberries in chocolate and drinks; other sweets not described (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bone_sai_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Strawberries and chocolate, coffee and cocktails; whether the chocolate contains dairy is not stated (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bone_sai_gion.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–01:00; hours may change (Tabelog; August 2025 review). Takeaway available (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 9 seats at the counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog). On the ground floor of Re:CubeGION2 in Gion north of Shijo, 5 min from Gion-Shijo; a bonsai-themed sign (Tabelog; June 2026 review).
kyoto_bone_sai_gion.notes: [Sweets & bar · Gion] A tiny nine-seat counter that is a café by afternoon and a bar by night, known for chocolate-dipped strawberries with gold leaf, espresso, highballs and gin until 1 am. About ¥2,000–4,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 December 2019 (Tabelog). Concept: "Sweets, Espresso, and a little Bar" (August 2025 review). Run single-handedly by a woman owner (January 2025 review), described as beautiful by guests in January 2025 and June 2026. The strawberries change daily, from contracted growers around Japan (June 2023 review); posted on Instagram stories (January 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A regular of four visits (October 2025) drops in after dinner around 7 pm for a Glenmorangie highball while friends have coffee.
A June 2026 group, finding the usual spot closed, followed the bonsai sign for a pre-party gin and the recommended strawberries.
An April 2025 visitor found the strawberries, about ten for ¥3,500, a little sour and the chocolate quick to melt.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ボーン サイ、バー・スイーツ、東山区祇園町北側347-150 Re:CubeGION2ビル1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 15:00〜翌1:00、テイクアウト可、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、9席、喫煙可、2019年12月23日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 「Sweets, Espresso, and a little Bar」、金箔をのせたチョコレートのいちご (約10粒3,500円、2025年4月)、Summer Lyrical などの品種、いちごミルク、エスプレッソ、Glenmorangie のハイボール、ジン、白ワイン、盆栽の看板、店主が一人で営む (2025年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_gion_asadaya.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kappo dishes; soy sauce and dashi are likely (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_asadaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sea urchin, fish and dashi (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_asadaya.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00; dinner 18:00–21:00; two groups a day; irregular closures — days are not given (Tabelog). Reservation only; same-day cancellations may be charged in full; four or more guests book the whole counter; call 9:00–11:30 or 15:30–17:30 (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog Japanese original 「サービス料・チャージ料なし」). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 6 counter seats; non-smoking; ages 10 and up; dress code (Tabelog). On Shinmonzen-dori east of Hanamikoji among antique shops, 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_asadaya.notes: [Kappo · Shinmonzen] A hidden six-seat counter among Shinmonzen's antique shops, where the owner cooks alone for just two groups a day — seasonal Kyoto and Ishikawa ingredients with sake and wine. About ¥15,000–20,000; booking only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 January 2015 (Tabelog). Trained for many years at kaiseki houses such as Kitcho (December 2016 review). Runs the place alone and researches new ingredients each season (August 2023 review). Signature in 2016–2019: Kawachi duck sushi (December 2016 and May 2019 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Tradition is the accumulation of innovation" — seasons expressed boldly, linking producers and guests (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A returning guest in May 2026, after a few years away, spent three happy hours with sake and singled out a jelly of sea urchin and edamame.
A November 2021 lunch couple, booking through Hitosara, could only get the ¥10,000 course and were the only guests that day, served by the owner alone.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 淺田屋、日本料理・魚介料理、東山区中之町247 (新門前通、花見小路の東)、京阪祇園四条駅・三条駅から徒歩5分、昼は12:00から、夜は18:00〜21:00、1日2組、不定休、予約のみ (当日キャンセルは100%の場合あり、4名以上は貸切)、電話は9:00〜11:30・15:30〜17:30、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カード可、電子マネー不可、カウンター6席、禁煙、10歳以上、ドレスコードあり、2015年1月23日オープン、京都と店主の故郷の石川と全国の食材、日本酒とワインにこだわり (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2016〜2026年、英語): 店主の Asada さんは Noto の出身、Kitcho などで長く修業 (2016年12月)、Kawachi の鴨の寿司 (2016〜2019年)、店主が一人で営む (2023年8月)、昼は8,000円と15,000円のコース (2021年11月)、雲丹と枝豆のジュレ (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; dress code; ages 10 and up (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_26_dining_cocon_karasuma.gf_detail: Not GF: soba (domestic wheat with buckwheat), tempura, karaage and chikuwa (2026 reviews).
kyoto_26_dining_cocon_karasuma.vegan_detail: Ask. Kyoto vegetables and tofu feature, e.g. steamed seasonal vegetables, but oden and most plates use dashi, chicken or pork (2026 reviews).
kyoto_26_dining_cocon_karasuma.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–23:00 (last order 22:00) (Tabelog); reviewers describe soba by day, with meal tickets bought first, and an izakaya at night (June–September 2026). Reservations accepted; a booking is cancelled if no contact 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Charge ¥550 incl. tax (Tabelog original チャージ料550円（税込み）). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 32 seats: 8 at the counter, 14 at tables, a private room for 10 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; smoking area nearby (Tabelog). COCON KARASUMA B1F, linked to Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo Stns (Tabelog). Opened 26 November 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_26_dining_cocon_karasuma.notes: [Kyoto-producer izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, COCON B1F] A stylish basement izakaya built around produce, chicken, pork and sake from all 26 municipalities of Kyoto Prefecture: steamed vegetables, whole-tomato oden, Tanba pork, chicken sashimi and tempura. Soba by day. ¥550 charge. Some found it pricey for the portions.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: opened 26 November 2025 in COCON KARASUMA; a concept of the Yojiya group named for Kyoto Prefecture's 26 cities and towns, with menus that introduce the producers (May–September 2026). Our crawls hold a second 26ダイニング near Kyoto City Hall.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients and sake from Kyoto Prefecture's producers (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Steamed Kyoto vegetables; Tanba pork oden.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor noticed magnets at the entrance marking where each ingredient came from, and a menu cover of fragrant Kyoto wood.
An August 2026 diner on the ¥4,500 course found the stream of small plates more than enough.
A May 2026 guest found the taste average and the Kyoto vegetables ordinary for the price.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・おでん・天ぷら、下京区水銀屋町620 COCON KARASUMA B1F、阪急烏丸駅23・25番出口と地下鉄四条駅2番出口直結、毎日 15:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、予約可 (30分連絡なしはキャンセル)、チャージ料550円 (税込)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・電子マネー・QR 可、32席 (カウンター8、テーブル14、個室10)、禁煙 (近くに喫煙所)、2025年11月26日開店、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): Yojiya グループ、京都府の26市町村にちなむ名前、京都の生産者の食材と酒、トマト丸ごとの冷やしおでん、京丹波の豚とシャキシャキ野菜880円、季節の蒸し野菜1,080円、白ちくわ580円、京の鶏のポン唐揚げ720円、鶏の刺身、とうもろこしのひげの天ぷら、なすの天ぷら、海老のかき揚げ、昼は国産のそば、コース4,500円、ASOBI ペールエール、値段のわりに普通との声 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥550 charge; non-smoking; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_maruyama_kagaribi.gf_detail: Ask. Yudofu is tofu in hot water, but it comes with ponzu, and sukiyaki uses a soy-sugar sauce; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_maruyama_kagaribi.vegan_detail: Ask. Yudofu is tofu, served with green onion and ponzu (February 2024); the dashi and the rest of the course may not be plant-based.
kyoto_gion_maruyama_kagaribi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00; closing days irregular (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; often booked out by groups (Tabelog; February and May 2024). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 200 seats in tatami rooms; private rooms and private hire (Tabelog). Inside Maruyama Park, north of the city car park, near Yasaka Shrine; entered past a large lantern (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_gion_maruyama_kagaribi.notes: [Yudofu and sukiyaki · Maruyama Park] A large tatami restaurant in the greenery of Maruyama Park, reached past a big lantern: Kyoto yudofu lunches and sukiyaki courses of good beef, popular with tour groups and business lunches. Book ahead. One 2024 visitor found the yudofu plain.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a 200-seat restaurant of tofu dishes, sukiyaki and eel in Maruyama Park, used by tour groups, company gatherings and business lunches (2017–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 business-lunch guest came in past the large lantern for sukiyaki dipped in egg in a quiet tatami room.
An October 2026 company meeting had yudofu for lunch, then a stroll in Maruyama Park before work.
A February 2024 tour-group diner found a generous block of tofu each but only green onion and ponzu to season it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豆腐料理・すき焼き・うなぎ、東山区円山公園市営駐車場北 祇園町北側350、毎日 11:00〜21:00、不定休、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、200席、座敷、個室、貸切可、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2017年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 円山公園の緑の中、大きな提灯をくぐって入る、団体の予約で満席のことも、湯豆腐 (ひとり豆腐1丁ほど、ねぎとポン酢)、すき焼きのコース (霜降りの牛肉、焼き豆腐、白菜、もやし、ねぎ、甘い割下、卵)、最後に甘味、会社の会合や商談の昼食に、湯豆腐の味が単調だったとの声 (2024年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Tatami rooms; book ahead; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_yamadaruma_rokkaku.gf_detail: Not GF: katsudon, karaage and ginger-pork sets at lunch, soy-based plates at night (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yamadaruma_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, firefly squid and pork or chicken lunch sets (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yamadaruma_rokkaku.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:30–13:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Saturday 17:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Tabelog also lists Sunday 17:00–23:00 but gives Sunday as the closing day (and Monday when it is a holiday), so Sunday is left out here. Lunch not bookable; dinner reservations accepted (Tabelog). Appetizer ¥330, not on course bookings (Tabelog original 付きだし330円(コース予約除く)). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (PayPay, d Barai); no e-money (Tabelog). 38 seats (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, including at lunch; some seats can be non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). Basement of the Daiki Rokkaku building, Rokkaku east of Karasuma; 4 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; December 2024).
kyoto_yamadaruma_rokkaku.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Rokkaku basement] A smoke-friendly basement izakaya near Karasuma: weekday lunch sets of katsudon or the daily special for about ¥900 with unlimited rice, and at night sashimi, dashimaki and a long list of sake by the glass. ¥330 appetizer. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a basement izakaya of fish and Japanese sake on Rokkaku east of Karasuma, popular for value weekday lunches, with smoking allowed (2024–2026 reviews). Our crawls hold a sister, 京都七条焼肉酒場 やまだるま.
chef_bio.specialty: Katsudon lunch set; sake by the glass.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 regular praised the ¥900 katsudon set with a salad and all-you-can-eat rice and miso soup.
An April 2025 smoker came looking for an izakaya where smoking is still allowed, and found the food safe and tasty.
An October 2026 lunch guest was impressed by the value of the daily set, though the smoke clung to a suit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、中京区烏丸六角東入堂之前町230-2 大輝六角ビル B1F、月〜金 11:30〜13:30 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、土 17:00〜23:00、日曜も記載あるが定休日は日曜 (月曜祝日の場合は月曜)、昼の予約は不可、付きだし330円 (コース予約除く)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・QR (PayPay・d払い) 可、電子マネー不可、38席、喫煙可 (一部禁煙可)。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年11月、英語): 地下の居酒屋、平日の昼の定食 (かつ丼、かつ煮、豚の生姜焼き、唐揚げ、日替わり) 850〜900円、ご飯と味噌汁のおかわり自由、夜は刺身の盛り合わせ、だし巻き、おばんざいの盛り合わせ、ほたるいか、たこ酢、グラスの日本酒が豊富、昼も喫煙可で服ににおいがつく (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed; lunch not bookable; ¥330 appetizer at night; cards and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_bake_and_treat.gf_detail: Not GF: sandwiches, Basque cheesecake, carrot cake, tiramisu and granola (September–October 2026).
kyoto_bake_and_treat.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheesecakes, cream cakes and yogurt (September 2026).
kyoto_bake_and_treat.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closing days irregular; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter and table seats in a wooden townhouse interior with a small garden at the back (September–October 2026). A 5 min walk from Shijo-Karasuma, on Nishikikoji west of Karasuma (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 13 December 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bake_and_treat.notes: [Café · Karasuma-Nishiki, townhouse, 9 a.m.–10 p.m.] A warm wooden townhouse café near Shijo-Karasuma open from breakfast to late evening: granola and sandwiches in the morning, then Basque cheesecakes, frozen tiramisu, carrot cake and kakigori parfaits with a flat white, looking onto a small garden.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a café opened 13 December 2024 in a renovated townhouse near Shijo-Karasuma, specialising in homemade sweets and sandwiches (September–October 2026).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor, recovering from a health check, had a light sandwich on bread from 968, a rare flat white and a mild carrot cake made with fresh cream.
A September 2026 pair shared the frozen tiramisu — crunchy then fluffy — and a caramelised Basque cheesecake with American coffee.
A September 2026 guest, curious since it opened two years before, had a mango kakigori glass parfait by the window onto the garden.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、中京区占出山町314-2、毎日 9:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、不定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2024年12月13日開店、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): 町家を生かした木のぬくもりの店内、奥に小さな庭、カウンターとテーブル席、手作りの菓子とサンドイッチ、朝はグラノーラとヨーグルト、968 のパンのサンドイッチとトマトソース、バスクチーズケーキ (かぼちゃも)、フローズンティラミス、生クリームのキャロットケーキ、マンゴーのかき氷のグラスパフェ、フラットホワイト、アメリカンコーヒー、四条烏丸から徒歩5分。

cultural_comfort.note: Open from breakfast to evening; no reservations; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_la_masa_spanish.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog's listing marks gluten-free options, and paella is a rice dish, but reviewers name tapas such as eggplant fritters and cakes (2024–2025) and no reviewer describes a gluten-free order.
kyoto_la_masa_spanish.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog's listing marks vegan and vegetarian options; the paellas reviewers ate used seafood, rabbit, chicken or sardines (2019–2025).
kyoto_la_masa_spanish.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–21:00 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 20:30); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken; a reviewer booked the day before on a full weekend night (December 2024). Cards (VISA, Master). 30 seats; a private room for 8; private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Children welcome. 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae exit 10. Opened 1 July 1998.
kyoto_la_masa_spanish.notes: [Spanish · near Kyoto City Hall, a paella house since 1998] A friendly, long-running Spanish bar near City Hall with paellas in half sizes — squid ink, sardine and tomato, red shrimp — plus tapas and a house wine; lunch from midday. Tabelog lists vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options — ask. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 1998 (Tabelog). A May 2025 reviewer writes that the owner lived in Spain; reviewers describe a cheerful owner and staff who explain the dishes, and a November 2023 reviewer heard that the chef of a well-known Tokyo Spanish restaurant came from here. Criticism: limited lunch choices (March 2019); a May 2025 reviewer found the pre-cut cakes and flan stale and too sweet.

anecdotes.text: September 2019: "The main dish, paella, was made with rabbit and chicken meat… According to the explanation, traditional paella doesn't actually use seafood."
November 2023: "The squid ink paella had a rich umami flavor, and it paired wonderfully with the crispy bits, making it my personal favorite."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スペイン料理 La Masa、スペイン料理・バル・魚介料理、中京区亀屋町380、地下鉄東西線京都市役所前駅10番出口から徒歩2分、月・火・木〜日・祝日11:30〜21:00 (料理L.O.20:00、ドリンクL.O.20:30)、水曜休み、予約可、カード (VISA・Master) 可、30席、8名の個室、貸切20名まで、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語メニュー、英語対応スタッフ、持ち込み可、子供可、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーの対応あり、1998年7月1日オープン、IshikawaのイカとTangoの鶏と野菜のパエリア、バスク風の鯛の丸焼き。口コミ (2018年11月〜2025年5月、英語): イカ墨のパエリア、いわしとトマトのパエリア、ガスパチョ、牡蠣、トリッパ (2023年11月)、ハーフサイズのパエリア、Gamagoriの赤えび、トルティージャ、いわしの白ワインマリネ、なすのフリット (2024年1月)、うさぎと鶏のパエリア (2019年9月)、バスクチーズケーキ、フラン、キャロットケーキ (2025年5月)、スペイン在住経験のある店主、明るい接客、甘味は作り置きとの声 (2025年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

kyoto_omoikawa_bar.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a food stop: a late-night bar whose snacks include kasujiru (sake-lees soup) in winter (2022–2026 reviews). Ask about drinks.
kyoto_omoikawa_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: snack menu not described beyond kasujiru (2022–2026 reviews). Drinks only otherwise — ask.
kyoto_omoikawa_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 20:00–5:00; closed on irregular days; hours may change. No reservations. Cards (JCB, AMEX). Designated smoking area. At the dead end of a narrow alley on the south side of Nishikikoji just west of Karasuma (2015–2026 reviews); 3 min walk from Shijo or Karasuma stations.
kyoto_omoikawa_bar.notes: [Late-night bar · Nishikikoji west of Karasuma, an alley bar till 5 am] A busy, friendly bar at the end of a dark little alley off Nishikikoji, where the owner, the "mama", gets strangers talking over highballs until 5 am; kasujiru soup in winter. About ¥3,000–5,000. Smoking area.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2015 describe a packed, lively bar where the owner — called the "mama", "she" in 2021 and 2026 reviews — remembers regulars, adjusts to each customer and connects guests with one another, with quick young staff and many regulars. A September 2023 reviewer notes that some people might not appreciate the style. The owner is sometimes out early in the evening (2022; April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Late-night drinks and conversation; kasujiru in winter.

anecdotes.text: October 2021: "I suspect this friendly vibe is due to Mama's knack for connecting customers with one another, which is probably why it always feels this way."

September 2023: "The quality of the drinks and food, the entertaining service from the owner, and the overall atmosphere are all outstanding. Some people might not appreciate it, but I believe that's a minority opinion."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おもい川、バー・ダイニングバー、中京区錦小路通烏丸西入占出山町310-8、地下鉄四条駅から徒歩3分、毎日20:00〜翌5:00、不定休、予約不可、カード (JCB・AMEX) 可、分煙。口コミ (2015年9月〜2026年4月、英語): 錦小路を烏丸から西へ入った細い路地の突き当たり、深夜まで常連でにぎわうバー、客同士をつなぐママ (2021年10月)、ハイボール、バーボンソーダ、冬の粕汁、飲み物も料理もおいしい (2023年)、好みが分かれるかもという声 (2023年9月)、ママが不在の時間も (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: A regulars-heavy, talkative late-night bar; no reservations; smoking area.

kyoto_tomoe_shokudo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki and Kyoto beta-yaki with udon, tenkasu and sauce; lunch of kara-age, katsu, fried fish and curry (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tomoe_shokudo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki with pork, squid, egg and bonito flakes; teppan horumon; fried lunches (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tomoe_shokudo.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); dinner Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Wednesday; dinner also closed the 2nd and 4th Thursday; no lunch on weekends or holidays. Reservations taken. Cards, IC, e-money and QR. 27 seats: 11 at the counter, 16 at sunken tables. Non-smoking. Children welcome. 2nd floor of 烏丸アネックス on Sanjo-dori, 2 min from Karasuma-Oike exit 5. Opened 23 November 2023.
kyoto_tomoe_shokudo.notes: [Okonomiyaki & lunch sets · Sanjo-dori by Karasuma-Oike, an upstairs diner] A friendly second-floor diner: weekday lunch sets of kara-age, fried fish or curry for about ¥1,000 with free large rice, then light Kyoto-style okonomiyaki, beta-yaki and teppan dishes at night. About ¥3,000–5,000 at dinner. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 November 2023 (Tabelog). A June 2024 reviewer describes a gentle middle-aged owner with a young man and woman on staff and many overseas guests; a December 2025 reviewer says the owner prepares most of the dishes himself, so food can take time, and lunch reviewers praise cheerful women staff (2024–2025). Lunch was paused in mid-2024 and later resumed. Criticism: a heavy, greasy kara-age (January 2026); cabbage left crunchy in one okonomiyaki (June 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto beta-yaki okonomiyaki; lunch set meals.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "It felt more like a nice teppan-yaki restaurant's okonomiyaki rather than the heavy type you might expect!"
April 2026: "When my lunch arrived, it included four large pieces of fried chicken, miso soup, pickles, salad, and a small side dish."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: トモヱ食堂、お好み焼き・カレー、中京区梅忠町20-1 烏丸アネックス2F、地下鉄烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩2分、昼は月・火・木・金11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜は月・火・木〜日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、水曜休み、夜は第2・第4木曜休み、土日・祝日の昼は休み、予約可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、27席 (カウンター11・掘りごたつ16)、禁煙、子供可、2023年11月23日オープン、昼はスパイスカレーと定食、夜はお好み焼きと鉄板焼き、京風の「べた焼き」。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年4月、英語): べたうどんモダン1,150円、ねぎまぜ+200円、鶏なんこつ600円、和牛ホルモンミックス800円、「赤ばくだん」550円、瓶ビール680円 (2024年6月)、唐揚げランチ1,000円 (ご飯大盛り無料)、とんかつ定食1,000円、牛すじカレー、焼きカレー、アジフライ、豚の生姜焼き、煮込みハンバーグ、焼きそば、とん平焼き、ほとんどの料理を店主が一人で作る (2025年12月)、唐揚げが重いとの声 (2026年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff used to overseas guests (June 2024).

kyoto_washu_kisai_yusan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura (pistachio, firefly squid, shiso-wrapped swordfish), ham katsu and soy-based dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_washu_kisai_yusan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, dashimaki with mentaiko and shirasu, duck, chicken and pork (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_washu_kisai_yusan.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Wednesday and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday; hours may change. Reservations taken — walk-ins were turned away on a full holiday night (February 2026); same-day booking by Instagram DM worked (July 2026). Starter charge ¥500 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お突き出し500円」. Cards. Heated tobacco in a smoking area in the hall; a reviewer was allowed to smoke inside (October 2026). L-shaped counter of about eight and two tables for four (April 2026). 2nd floor of building 5 of the 湯浅会館 at Gojo-Takakura, a renovated complex of small restaurants (2025–2026 reviews). Opened 29 March 2024.
kyoto_washu_kisai_yusan.notes: [Sake izakaya · Gojo-Takakura, upstairs in the Yuasa Kaikan] A small, stylish sake bar-izakaya in a renovated old building, pouring a long list of sake (including its own label) with creative plates — pistachio tempura, mentaiko dashimaki, crab chawanmushi — at about ¥5,000–8,000. ¥500 starter charge; book ahead at weekends. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 March 2024 (Tabelog). A July 2026 reviewer writes that it is run by the owner and a male part-time staff member; a September 2025 reviewer describes a friendly manager training new staff. Reviewers praise the sake list, served in tin cups (September 2025), and the setting. Criticism: thin duck (April 2025), quality that comes at a price (April 2025), and flavors a bit lacking overall (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: June 2025: "The Pistachio Tempura is a must-try dish. It was the perfect accompaniment that made me want to keep drinking Japanese sake."
September 2025: "As this is a sake-focused establishment, there were many unique options available… The use of tin glasses showed the seriousness and high standards this restaurant has for its sake."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和酒季彩ゆう餐、居酒屋、下京区五条高倉上がる亀屋町172 湯浅会館5号館2F、五条駅から306m、月・火・木〜日17:00〜24:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.23:30)、水曜と第1・第3火曜休み、予約可、原文で「お突き出し500円」、カード可、加熱式たばこのみ館内に喫煙所、2024年3月29日オープン。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 日本酒中心の居酒屋、高い天井と坪庭の眺め、ピスタチオの天ぷら850円、小芋とたこの炊いたん1,000円、明太子としらすのだし巻き1,000円 (2025年6月)、4品のお通し、刺身の盛り合わせ、ほたるいかと山菜の天ぷら、京鴨、Tanba黒鶏の炭火焼、Unzenハムカツ、スナップえんどうと蒸し鶏の明太マヨ、牡蠣の焼きおにぎり、蟹の茶碗蒸し、竹炭の真っ黒なエビマヨ (2026年10月)、オリジナルの日本酒「ゆう餐」、錫の器、店主と男性アルバイトで営む (2026年7月)、鴨が薄い・値段なりとの声 (2025年4月)、味がやや物足りないとの声 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥500 starter charge; book ahead at weekends.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated September and October 2026.

kyoto_kyo_izakaya_sherry.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, tempura, gyoza, nama-fu dengaku, yuba rolls and miso-grilled chicken; no gluten information (Tabelog menu; April 2026).
kyoto_kyo_izakaya_sherry.vegan_detail: Ask. Yuba sashimi, nama-fu dengaku and fried nama-fu with tofu are listed, but nothing is said about dashi or sauces (Tabelog menu).
kyoto_kyo_izakaya_sherry.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday 17:00–22:30 (L.O. food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Wednesday and on irregular days (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 45 seats: counter, tables, a tatami room for up to 20 and a sunken-kotatsu private room for 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; smoking outside (Tabelog). At the east end of Gojo bridge, 2 min from exit 4 of Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_izakaya_sherry.notes: [Kyoto izakaya · east end of Gojo bridge, obanzai and tempura] A roomy izakaya by Gojo bridge with a counter, tables, a big tatami room and a kotatsu room: Kyoto obanzai, seven-kind tempura, yuba and nama-fu dishes, sashimi and beef tongue. Good for groups; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes counter and table seats, a tatami room for parties of up to 20 and a kotatsu room for 6. An April 2026 visitor felt the care in each obanzai. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor, sent by a friend, came for the obanzai wanted in Kyoto and added a sashimi platter and beef tongue.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京居酒屋 シェリー、居酒屋・日本料理・天ぷら、東山区五条大橋東入ル東橋詰町30、京阪清水五条駅4番出口から東へ徒歩2分、月・火・木〜日 17:00〜22:30 (L.O.料理21:30、飲物22:00)、水曜定休・不定休、カード可、45席、20名までの座敷、6名の掘りごたつ個室、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、おばんざい5種盛り1,320円、極上天ぷら7種盛り1,958円、京湯葉の刺身880円、生麩田楽660円、生麩と豆腐の揚げ出し715円、サーモンとクリームチーズの湯葉巻き935円、肉汁爆発餃子935円、鶏ももと九条ねぎの味噌ホイル焼き968円、たこわさ418円。口コミ (2026年4月、英語): 刺身盛り合わせ、牛タン、丁寧なおばんざい。

cultural_comfort.note: Roomy, with private rooms for groups.

kyoto_gion_roka_sowaka.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kaiseki with tempura, saikyo-miso grilled fish, chawanmushi and dashi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_roka_sowaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki built on dashi, with fish, Wagyu, crab and abalone (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_roka_sowaka.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:30) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 19:30) daily; closing days may vary (Tabelog). Reservations recommended — tables fill even on weekdays (March 2026). Seasonal special lunch kaiseki “Kai” ¥11,000 incl. tax and service (October 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 34 seats with a garden view (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In the small hotel SOWAKA, a renovated former ryotei on Shimogawara-dori south of the Yasaka torii, about 10 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_gion_roka_sowaka.notes: [Kaiseki · Shimogawara near Yasaka, a hotel garden room] The restaurant of SOWAKA, a small hotel in a renovated ryotei south of Yasaka Shrine: seasonal kaiseki at lunch and dinner by the garden, opening with a cup of warm dashi — courses from about ¥8,000, the ¥11,000 lunch “Kai” including service. Flagged: a hotel restaurant (a single small hotel).

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the restaurant as part of the hotel SOWAKA, a renovated former ryotei that blends Japanese and modern design (July and October 2026), and praise attentive service (June and July 2026). Tabelog’s shop text mentions walls of polished Otsu plaster.
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out seasonal ingredients in kaiseki (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 guest who arrived late in humid weather was handed a chilled towel in place of the hot one.
A July 2026 lunch came with the sounds of a Gion Matsuri float dedication outside in the rain.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園ろか、日本料理・創作料理、東山区下河原通八坂鳥居前下ル清井町480、祇園四条駅から徒歩約10分、昼 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.13:30)、夜 17:30〜22:00 (L.O.19:30)、不定休、カード可、34席、禁煙、旬の食材の昼のコースと夜の会席、大津磨きの黒い壁、コース8,200円・11,000円・24,000円。口コミ (2026年、英語): ホテルSOWAKAの中、元料亭を改装、庭の緑、温かい出汁から、湯葉の茶碗蒸しととうもろこしのムース、金時人参のドレッシング、甘いイカの刺身、皮のぱりっとした鶏、春の鰆の西京焼き、天ぷら、桜海老と筍のご飯、季節の特別会席「Kai」11,000円 (税・サ込み)、鱧の揚げ物、鯖寿司、蟹と水菜、和牛、鮑、冷たいおしぼり。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; attentive service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_le_palais_gourmand_sugimoto.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pies, cakes, baumkuchen and madeleines (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_le_palais_gourmand_sugimoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, mousse au fromage and butter pastries (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_le_palais_gourmand_sugimoto.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 10:30–19:00; closed Monday, or the day after when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR; pay first at the counter (Tabelog; November 2025). 13 seats: 3 at the counter and 5 tables for two, for cake and coffee in the shop; cakes also to take away (Tabelog; January 2026). On Sanjo-dori east of Sanjo bridge, 3 min from exit 1 of Sanjo Keihan (Tabelog).
kyoto_le_palais_gourmand_sugimoto.notes: [Patisserie café · Sanjo-dori by the bridge, classic cakes] An established little patisserie in deep green just east of Sanjo bridge, with classic cakes, apple and cherry pies baked on site and a homely corner of tables for cake and coffee (¥50 off coffee with a cake); popular cakes sell out by evening. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe an established shop with a homely owner and a handwritten menu (January and February 2026). No founding date was found.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor asked staff for a recommendation and was steered to the apple pie, served cold with hot coffee.
A freezing February 2026 afternoon brought one visitor in for warm coffee and a mousse au fromage.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ル・パレ・グルマン・スギモト、ケーキ・カフェ、東山区三条大橋東3-35、地下鉄三条京阪駅1番出口から徒歩3分、火〜日 10:30〜19:00、月曜定休 (祝日の場合は翌日)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、13席 (カウンター3、2人掛けテーブル5)、手提げ袋は6円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昔ながらのケーキの老舗、焼きたてのアップルパイとチェリーパイ、冷たいアップルパイとコーヒー、前払いで現金のみ、シャンティショコラ620円、ブレンドコーヒー550円 (ケーキと一緒なら50円引き)、ムースオフロマージュ、焼きたてのりんごのケーキ、バウムクーヘン、抹茶小豆のケーキ、マドレーヌ、家庭的な店主、手書きのメニュー、夕方には売り切れも。

cultural_comfort.note: Small café corner; pay first; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_dunstan_coffee_roasters.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee only — no food or sweets are served (February 2025).
kyoto_dunstan_coffee_roasters.vegan_detail: Hand-drip coffee and Americano are served black (2025–26 reviews); lattes use milk. Coffee only, no food (February 2025).
kyoto_dunstan_coffee_roasters.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Wed and Sat 9:30–11:30; closed Thursday, Friday and Sunday; may change (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A counter at the back and benches and tables at the front; takeaway (Tabelog; February 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ragusa Higashinotoin-Takatsuji 1F, about 6 min from Shijo, Karasuma or Gojo stations (Tabelog). Opened 29 April 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_dunstan_coffee_roasters.notes: [Coffee stand · Takatsuji, mornings only] A tiny roaster that looks like a select shop outside and a small church inside, run by a former designer: nine single-origin and blend beans with poetic names, hand-dripped at ¥700–900, plus lattes. Open only 9:30–11:30 on four mornings a week; coffee only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a coffee stand and roaster opened in April 2022 near Bukkoji, with a church-inspired interior designed by its owner, formerly a designer.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor chose the DUNSTAN BLEND from nine beans with names like prayers, using a roast chart.
A February 2026 visitor picked the fruitiest bean, REALLY GOOD LUCK, in a large cup and called it the fruitiest coffee yet.
A March 2025 visitor arriving near closing took two lattes to go.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒースタンド・カフェ、下京区燈籠町559-2 Ragusa東洞院高辻 1F、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄五条駅から徒歩約6分、月・火・水・土9:30〜11:30、木・金・日休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、カウンターとベンチ、テイクアウト、禁煙、2022年4月29日オープン。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年8月、英語): 教会のような店内、元デザイナーの店主、コーヒーのみで料理や菓子はない、ハンドドリップ700円 (300ml)・900円 (450ml)、詩のような名前の9種の豆、焙煎の表、カフェラテ、アメリカーノ。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose a bean from the roast chart and order at the counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through August 2026.
